learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 02-49。

en.title: Restaurant service case 02-49: out-of-order service on the number screen
en.summary: Case 02-49 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We reserved two burners for takeaway capacity and re-measured at the same site. The forecasting model had its parameters changed once, and the metric definition followed.
en.outcome: out-of-order complaints fell from 31 to 4 that month (case 02-49).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 02-49.

title: 农田灌溉案例 02-50：土壤湿度探头的雨后误启动
summary: 农田灌溉第 02-50 号案例。现场反馈的是雨后误启动，排查后定位到土壤湿度探头与首部过滤器的配合方式。处理办法是在首部加了旁通，并在同一地点复测确认。写明什么时候可以跳过复核。
outcome: 反冲洗次数每天从 9 次降到 3 次（案例 02-50）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 02-50。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 02-50: false start after rain on the soil moisture probe
en.summary: Case 02-50 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was false start after rain, traced to how the soil moisture probe interacts with the head filter. We added a bypass at the head and re-measured at the same site. We spelled out when the review can be skipped.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 02-50).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 02-50.

title: 医院排班案例 02-51：换班申请单的换班链断裂
summary: 医院排班第 02-51 号案例。现场反馈的是换班链断裂，排查后定位到换班申请单与科室人力池的配合方式。处理办法是把连班上限写进模板校验，并在同一地点复测确认。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 02-51）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 02-51。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 02-51: broken swap chain on the swap request form
en.summary: Case 02-51 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the swap request form interacts with the department staffing pool. We moved the back-to-back cap into template validation and re-measured at the same site. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 02-51).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 02-51.

title: 地铁调度案例 02-52：早高峰加开车的开门时间超标
summary: 地铁调度第 02-52 号案例。现场反馈的是开门时间超标，排查后定位到早高峰加开车与站台屏蔽门的配合方式。处理办法是把折返作业拆成两段并行，并在同一地点复测确认。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。上线前评估过会不会影响夜间作业。
outcome: 折返作业时间从 142 秒压到 118 秒（案例 02-52）。
learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 02-52。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 02-52: door dwell overrun on the peak extra train
en.summary: Case 02-52 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was door dwell overrun, traced to how the peak extra train interacts with the platform screen door. We split the turnback into two parallel phases and re-measured at the same site. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one. Before rollout we assessed whether night operations would be affected.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 02-52).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 02-52.

title: 冷链物流案例 02-53：装卸月台的月台温升
summary: 冷链物流第 02-53 号案例。现场反馈的是月台温升，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是把预冷时长按品类分档，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。上线前评估过会不会影响夜间作业。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 02-53）。
learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 02-53。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 02-53: dock temperature rise on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 02-53 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We tiered pre-cooling time by product category and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest. Before rollout we assessed whether night operations would be affected.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 02-53).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 02-53.

title: 快递分拣案例 02-54：交叉带分拣机的交叉带打滑
summary: 快递分拣第 02-54 号案例。现场反馈的是交叉带打滑，排查后定位到交叉带分拣机与格口分配表的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 格口爆仓每班从 7 次降到 1 次（案例 02-54）。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 02-54。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 02-54: cross-belt slippage on the cross-belt sorter
en.summary: Case 02-54 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was cross-belt slippage, traced to how the cross-belt sorter interacts with the chute allocation table. We reordered chute allocation by destination flow and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: chute overflows per shift fell from 7 to 1 (case 02-54).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 02-54.

title: 光伏运维案例 02-55：倾角支架的日报口径不一致
summary: 光伏运维第 02-55 号案例。现场反馈的是日报口径不一致，排查后定位到倾角支架与发电量日报的配合方式。处理办法是按季节调了两次倾角，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 同口径发电量差异从 6% 收到 1%（案例 02-55）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 02-55。

en.title: PV plant operations case 02-55: inconsistent report definitions on the tilt mount
en.summary: Case 02-55 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was inconsistent report definitions, traced to how the tilt mount interacts with the daily generation report. We adjusted tilt twice by season and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: same-definition generation gap narrowed from 6% to 1% (case 02-55).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 02-55.

title: 图书借阅案例 02-56：自助借还机的索书号错架
summary: 图书借阅第 02-56 号案例。现场反馈的是索书号错架，排查后定位到自助借还机与书目索书号的配合方式。处理办法是按楼层重排索书号巡架顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。
outcome: 逾期通知送达率从 82% 升到 99%（案例 02-56）。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 02-56。

en.title: Library lending case 02-56: misshelved call numbers on the self-service kiosk
en.summary: Case 02-56 in Library lending. The reported problem was misshelved call numbers, traced to how the self-service kiosk interacts with the call number. We reordered shelf-reading by floor and re-measured at the same site. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way.
en.outcome: overdue notice delivery rose from 82% to 99% (case 02-56).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 02-56.

title: 水产养殖案例 02-57：投饵机的滤床短路流
summary: 水产养殖第 02-57 号案例。现场反馈的是滤床短路流，排查后定位到投饵机与水质探头的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 02-57）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 02-57。

en.title: Aquaculture case 02-57: filter bed short-circuiting on the feeder
en.summary: Case 02-57 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the feeder interacts with the water quality probe. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 02-57).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 02-57.

title: 城市停车案例 02-58：道闸的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 02-58 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到道闸与车位诱导屏的配合方式。处理办法是把识别结果加了二次比对，并在同一地点复测确认。预测用的模型换过一次参数，口径随之更新。
outcome: 共享车位周转率提高一倍（案例 02-58）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 02-58。

en.title: Urban parking case 02-58: stale guidance data on the barrier gate
en.summary: Case 02-58 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the barrier gate interacts with the guidance screen. We added a second comparison to plate results and re-measured at the same site. The forecasting model had its parameters changed once, and the metric definition followed.
en.outcome: shared bay turnover doubled (case 02-58).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 02-58.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 02-59：叫号屏的备餐台拥堵
summary: 餐饮出餐第 02-59 号案例。现场反馈的是备餐台拥堵，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是把备餐台按冷热分区，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 出餐乱序投诉当月从 31 条降到 4 条（案例 02-59）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 02-59。

en.title: Restaurant service case 02-59: prep counter congestion on the number screen
en.summary: Case 02-59 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep counter congestion, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-order complaints fell from 31 to 4 that month (case 02-59).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 02-59.

title: 农田灌溉案例 02-60：田间气象站的末端压力不足
summary: 农田灌溉第 02-60 号案例。现场反馈的是末端压力不足，排查后定位到田间气象站与干管阀组的配合方式。处理办法是把轮次表按地块高差重排了一遍，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 反冲洗次数每天从 9 次降到 3 次（案例 02-60）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 02-60。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 02-60: insufficient tail pressure on the field weather station
en.summary: Case 02-60 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was insufficient tail pressure, traced to how the field weather station interacts with the main valve group. We reordered the rotation table by plot elevation and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 02-60).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 02-60.

title: 医院排班案例 02-61：夜班组的换班链断裂
summary: 医院排班第 02-61 号案例。现场反馈的是换班链断裂，排查后定位到夜班组与值班表模板的配合方式。处理办法是让台账以打卡为准，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 连班超时当月从 14 例降到 0 例（案例 02-61）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 02-61。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 02-61: broken swap chain on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 02-61 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We made clock-in authoritative for the ledger and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 02-61).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 02-61.

title: 地铁调度案例 02-62：折返线的间隔波动
summary: 地铁调度第 02-62 号案例。现场反馈的是间隔波动，排查后定位到折返线与列车间隔表的配合方式。处理办法是把折返作业拆成两段并行，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。排产用的模型只按历史均值走，遇到突发就偏。
outcome: 早高峰间隔波动从 ±35 秒收到 ±12 秒（案例 02-62）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 02-62。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 02-62: headway jitter on the turnback track
en.summary: Case 02-62 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was headway jitter, traced to how the turnback track interacts with the headway table. We split the turnback into two parallel phases and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest. The scheduling model follows historical averages only and drifts under sudden load.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 02-62).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 02-62.

title: 冷链物流案例 02-63：温度记录仪的月台温升
summary: 冷链物流第 02-63 号案例。现场反馈的是月台温升，排查后定位到温度记录仪与装卸月台的配合方式。处理办法是按里程与季节重算干冰配额，并在同一地点复测确认。定了什么时候必须停线检查。
outcome: 月台温升从 6.5 摄氏度降到 2.1 摄氏度（案例 02-63）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 02-63。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 02-63: dock temperature rise on the temperature logger
en.summary: Case 02-63 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the temperature logger interacts with the loading dock. We recomputed dry ice quota by distance and season and re-measured at the same site. We set when the line must stop for inspection.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 02-63).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 02-63.

title: 快递分拣案例 02-64：格口分配表的返流比例升高
summary: 快递分拣第 02-64 号案例。现场反馈的是返流比例升高，排查后定位到格口分配表与面单识别相机的配合方式。处理办法是在入口加了异形件预分流，并在同一地点复测确认。现场问过一句：能不能先按老办法顶两天。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 02-64。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 02-64: rising recirculation ratio on the chute allocation table
en.summary: Case 02-64 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was rising recirculation ratio, traced to how the chute allocation table interacts with the label camera. We added irregular-item pre-diversion at the inlet and re-measured at the same site. Someone on site asked whether the old procedure could hold for two more days.
en.outcome: label recognition recovered from 93.5% to 99.1% (case 02-64).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 02-64.

title: 光伏运维案例 02-65：清洗机器人的汇流箱温升
summary: 光伏运维第 02-65 号案例。现场反馈的是汇流箱温升，排查后定位到清洗机器人与倾角支架的配合方式。处理办法是按组串电流分布重新分组，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 组串失配损失从 4.1% 降到 1.3%（案例 02-65）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 02-65。

en.title: PV plant operations case 02-65: combiner box temperature rise on the cleaning robot
en.summary: Case 02-65 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the cleaning robot interacts with the tilt mount. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 02-65).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 02-65.

title: 图书借阅案例 02-66：预约队列的索书号错架
summary: 图书借阅第 02-66 号案例。现场反馈的是索书号错架，排查后定位到预约队列与逾期通知的配合方式。处理办法是给预约队列加了到馆时限，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 逾期通知送达率从 82% 升到 99%（案例 02-66）。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 02-66。

en.title: Library lending case 02-66: misshelved call numbers on the reservation queue
en.summary: Case 02-66 in Library lending. The reported problem was misshelved call numbers, traced to how the reservation queue interacts with the overdue notice. We added a pickup deadline to the reservation queue and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: overdue notice delivery rose from 82% to 99% (case 02-66).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 02-66.

title: 水产养殖案例 02-67：投饵机的滤床短路流
summary: 水产养殖第 02-67 号案例。现场反馈的是滤床短路流，排查后定位到投饵机与水质探头的配合方式。处理办法是把分池操作挪到清晨低温时段，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 02-67）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 02-67。

en.title: Aquaculture case 02-67: filter bed short-circuiting on the feeder
en.summary: Case 02-67 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the feeder interacts with the water quality probe. We moved partitioning to the cool early morning and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 02-67).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 02-67.

title: 城市停车案例 02-68：车位诱导屏的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 02-68 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到车位诱导屏与高位视频桩的配合方式。处理办法是把识别结果加了二次比对，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 02-68）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 02-68。

en.title: Urban parking case 02-68: stale guidance data on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 02-68 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We added a second comparison to plate results and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 02-68).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 02-68.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 02-69：高峰配菜表的叫号漏叫
summary: 餐饮出餐第 02-69 号案例。现场反馈的是叫号漏叫，排查后定位到高峰配菜表与出餐口的配合方式。处理办法是把出餐改成按下单时间强排序，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 02-69）。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 02-69。

en.title: Restaurant service case 02-69: missed calls on the peak prep sheet
en.summary: Case 02-69 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was missed calls, traced to how the peak prep sheet interacts with the service window. We forced service order by order time and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 02-69).
en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 02-69.

title: 农田灌溉案例 02-70：干管阀组的轮次冲突
summary: 农田灌溉第 02-70 号案例。现场反馈的是轮次冲突，排查后定位到干管阀组与土壤湿度探头的配合方式。处理办法是把反冲洗周期改成按压差触发，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 末端压力从 0.12 兆帕回到 0.19 兆帕（案例 02-70）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 02-70。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 02-70: rotation conflicts on the main valve group
en.summary: Case 02-70 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was rotation conflicts, traced to how the main valve group interacts with the soil moisture probe. We switched backwash to differential-pressure triggering and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: tail pressure recovered from 0.12 MPa to 0.19 MPa (case 02-70).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 02-70.

title: 医院排班案例 02-71：夜班组的换班链断裂
summary: 医院排班第 02-71 号案例。现场反馈的是换班链断裂，排查后定位到夜班组与值班表模板的配合方式。处理办法是把节假日缺口提前四周预警，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 02-71）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 02-71。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 02-71: broken swap chain on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 02-71 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We raised holiday shortfall alerts four weeks ahead and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 02-71).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 02-71.

title: 地铁调度案例 02-72：列车间隔表的闸机限流不及时
summary: 地铁调度第 02-72 号案例。现场反馈的是闸机限流不及时，排查后定位到列车间隔表与客流闸机的配合方式。处理办法是按站间实际运行时分重算间隔表，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 开门时间超标当周清零（案例 02-72）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 02-72。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 02-72: late gate throttling on the headway table
en.summary: Case 02-72 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was late gate throttling, traced to how the headway table interacts with the passenger gate. We recomputed the headway table from measured section times and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: door dwell overruns fell to zero that week (case 02-72).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 02-72.

title: 冷链物流案例 02-73：干冰配额表的月台温升
summary: 冷链物流第 02-73 号案例。现场反馈的是月台温升，排查后定位到干冰配额表与冷藏箱体的配合方式。处理办法是把记录仪采样从 5 分钟改成 1 分钟，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 02-73）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 02-73。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 02-73: dock temperature rise on the dry ice quota table
en.summary: Case 02-73 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the dry ice quota table interacts with the refrigerated container. We changed logger sampling from 5 minutes to 1 minute and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 02-73).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 02-73.

title: 快递分拣案例 02-74：异形件通道的交叉带打滑
summary: 快递分拣第 02-74 号案例。现场反馈的是交叉带打滑，排查后定位到异形件通道与返流皮带的配合方式。处理办法是在入口加了异形件预分流，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 02-74。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 02-74: cross-belt slippage on the irregular-item lane
en.summary: Case 02-74 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was cross-belt slippage, traced to how the irregular-item lane interacts with the recirculation belt. We added irregular-item pre-diversion at the inlet and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: label recognition recovered from 93.5% to 99.1% (case 02-74).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 02-74.

title: 光伏运维案例 02-75：发电量日报的清洗周期不合理
summary: 光伏运维第 02-75 号案例。现场反馈的是清洗周期不合理，排查后定位到发电量日报与组串逆变器的配合方式。处理办法是把汇流箱巡检改成红外筛查，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 组串失配损失从 4.1% 降到 1.3%（案例 02-75）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 02-75。

en.title: PV plant operations case 02-75: unsuitable cleaning cycle on the daily generation report
en.summary: Case 02-75 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was unsuitable cleaning cycle, traced to how the daily generation report interacts with the string inverter. We switched combiner inspection to infrared screening and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 02-75).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 02-75.

title: 图书借阅案例 02-76：逾期通知的逾期通知漏发
summary: 图书借阅第 02-76 号案例。现场反馈的是逾期通知漏发，排查后定位到逾期通知与密集书库的配合方式。处理办法是把密集书库取书按区块批量化，并在同一地点复测确认。争论点是能不能只改一处就够。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 02-76。

en.title: Library lending case 02-76: missed overdue notices on the overdue notice
en.summary: Case 02-76 in Library lending. The reported problem was missed overdue notices, traced to how the overdue notice interacts with the compact stacks. We batched compact-stack retrieval by block and re-measured at the same site. The argument was whether changing one place would be enough. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 02-76).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 02-76.

title: 水产养殖案例 02-77：水质探头的滤床短路流
summary: 水产养殖第 02-77 号案例。现场反馈的是滤床短路流，排查后定位到水质探头与循环水滤床的配合方式。处理办法是按体重重算投饵率，并在同一地点复测确认。补了一段为什么之前的判据不适用。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 02-77。

en.title: Aquaculture case 02-77: filter bed short-circuiting on the water quality probe
en.summary: Case 02-77 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the water quality probe interacts with the recirculating filter bed. We recomputed feeding rate by body weight and re-measured at the same site. We added a note on why the earlier criterion did not apply. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: feed coefficient fell from 1.62 to 1.28 (case 02-77).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 02-77.

title: 城市停车案例 02-78：包月名单的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 02-78 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到包月名单与错峰共享车位的配合方式。处理办法是让包月名单按天同步，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 02-78）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 02-78。

en.title: Urban parking case 02-78: stale guidance data on the monthly pass list
en.summary: Case 02-78 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the monthly pass list interacts with the off-peak shared bay. We synced the pass list daily and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 02-78).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 02-78.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 02-79：叫号屏的叫号漏叫
summary: 餐饮出餐第 02-79 号案例。现场反馈的是叫号漏叫，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是把备餐台按冷热分区，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 02-79）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 02-79。

en.title: Restaurant service case 02-79: missed calls on the number screen
en.summary: Case 02-79 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was missed calls, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 02-79).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 02-79.

title: 农田灌溉案例 02-80：田间气象站的末端压力不足
summary: 农田灌溉第 02-80 号案例。现场反馈的是末端压力不足，排查后定位到田间气象站与干管阀组的配合方式。处理办法是把反冲洗周期改成按压差触发，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。估算用的模型没考虑季节项。算过一遍会不会超出现有产能。
outcome: 轮次冲突当季清零（案例 02-80）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 02-80。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 02-80: insufficient tail pressure on the field weather station
en.summary: Case 02-80 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was insufficient tail pressure, traced to how the field weather station interacts with the main valve group. We switched backwash to differential-pressure triggering and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way. The estimation model left out the seasonal term. We worked out whether it would exceed current capacity.
en.outcome: rotation conflicts fell to zero for the season (case 02-80).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 02-80.

title: 医院排班案例 02-81：加班台账的连班超时
summary: 医院排班第 02-81 号案例。现场反馈的是连班超时，排查后定位到加班台账与夜班组的配合方式。处理办法是把连班上限写进模板校验，并在同一地点复测确认。上线前评估过会不会影响夜间作业。
outcome: 连班超时当月从 14 例降到 0 例（案例 02-81）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 02-81。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 02-81: back-to-back shift overrun on the overtime ledger
en.summary: Case 02-81 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was back-to-back shift overrun, traced to how the overtime ledger interacts with the night shift group. We moved the back-to-back cap into template validation and re-measured at the same site. Before rollout we assessed whether night operations would be affected.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 02-81).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 02-81.

title: 地铁调度案例 02-82：折返线的加开车占用冲突
summary: 地铁调度第 02-82 号案例。现场反馈的是加开车占用冲突，排查后定位到折返线与列车间隔表的配合方式。处理办法是给加开车固定了占用窗口，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 开门时间超标当周清零（案例 02-82）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 02-82。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 02-82: extra-train occupancy conflict on the turnback track
en.summary: Case 02-82 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was extra-train occupancy conflict, traced to how the turnback track interacts with the headway table. We fixed an occupancy window for extra trains and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: door dwell overruns fell to zero that week (case 02-82).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 02-82.

title: 冷链物流案例 02-83：装卸月台的月台温升
summary: 冷链物流第 02-83 号案例。现场反馈的是月台温升，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是把预冷时长按品类分档，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 02-83）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 02-83。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 02-83: dock temperature rise on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 02-83 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We tiered pre-cooling time by product category and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 02-83).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 02-83.

title: 快递分拣案例 02-84：交叉带分拣机的返流比例升高
summary: 快递分拣第 02-84 号案例。现场反馈的是返流比例升高，排查后定位到交叉带分拣机与格口分配表的配合方式。处理办法是把返流皮带速度与主线解耦，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 02-84。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 02-84: rising recirculation ratio on the cross-belt sorter
en.summary: Case 02-84 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was rising recirculation ratio, traced to how the cross-belt sorter interacts with the chute allocation table. We decoupled recirculation belt speed from the main line and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: label recognition recovered from 93.5% to 99.1% (case 02-84).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 02-84.

title: 光伏运维案例 02-85：汇流箱的组串失配
summary: 光伏运维第 02-85 号案例。现场反馈的是组串失配，排查后定位到汇流箱与清洗机器人的配合方式。处理办法是按组串电流分布重新分组，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 02-85）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 02-85。

en.title: PV plant operations case 02-85: string mismatch on the combiner box
en.summary: Case 02-85 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was string mismatch, traced to how the combiner box interacts with the cleaning robot. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 02-85).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 02-85.

title: 图书借阅案例 02-86：密集书库的逾期通知漏发
summary: 图书借阅第 02-86 号案例。现场反馈的是逾期通知漏发，排查后定位到密集书库与自助借还机的配合方式。处理办法是给预约队列加了到馆时限，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。核对了是不是上一版参数没同步。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 预约平均等待从 11 天降到 4 天（案例 02-86）。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 02-86。

en.title: Library lending case 02-86: missed overdue notices on the compact stacks
en.summary: Case 02-86 in Library lending. The reported problem was missed overdue notices, traced to how the compact stacks interacts with the self-service kiosk. We added a pickup deadline to the reservation queue and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise. We checked whether the previous parameter set had not been synced. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 02-86).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 02-86.

title: 水产养殖案例 02-87：水质探头的滤床短路流
summary: 水产养殖第 02-87 号案例。现场反馈的是滤床短路流，排查后定位到水质探头与循环水滤床的配合方式。处理办法是把增氧机改成按溶氧闭环启停，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 02-87）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 02-87。

en.title: Aquaculture case 02-87: filter bed short-circuiting on the water quality probe
en.summary: Case 02-87 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the water quality probe interacts with the recirculating filter bed. We switched aerators to closed-loop dissolved-oxygen control and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 02-87).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 02-87.

title: 城市停车案例 02-88：高位视频桩的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 02-88 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到高位视频桩与包月名单的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 02-88）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 02-88。

en.title: Urban parking case 02-88: stale guidance data on the overhead video pole
en.summary: Case 02-88 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the overhead video pole interacts with the monthly pass list. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 02-88).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 02-88.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 02-89：叫号屏的出餐乱序
summary: 餐饮出餐第 02-89 号案例。现场反馈的是出餐乱序，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是把外卖产能单独留了两个灶口，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 02-89。

en.title: Restaurant service case 02-89: out-of-order service on the number screen
en.summary: Case 02-89 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We reserved two burners for takeaway capacity and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: missed-call rate fell from 5.1% to 0.4% (case 02-89).
en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 02-89.

title: 农田灌溉案例 02-90：干管阀组的雨后误启动
summary: 农田灌溉第 02-90 号案例。现场反馈的是雨后误启动，排查后定位到干管阀组与土壤湿度探头的配合方式。处理办法是给探头加了两点标定，并在同一地点复测确认。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 02-90）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 02-90。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 02-90: false start after rain on the main valve group
en.summary: Case 02-90 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was false start after rain, traced to how the main valve group interacts with the soil moisture probe. We added two-point calibration to the probe and re-measured at the same site. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 02-90).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 02-90.

title: 医院排班案例 02-91：科室人力池的连班超时
summary: 医院排班第 02-91 号案例。现场反馈的是连班超时，排查后定位到科室人力池与加班台账的配合方式。处理办法是把节假日缺口提前四周预警，并在同一地点复测确认。现场问过一句：能不能先按老办法顶两天。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 02-91）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 02-91。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 02-91: back-to-back shift overrun on the department staffing pool
en.summary: Case 02-91 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was back-to-back shift overrun, traced to how the department staffing pool interacts with the overtime ledger. We raised holiday shortfall alerts four weeks ahead and re-measured at the same site. Someone on site asked whether the old procedure could hold for two more days. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 02-91).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 02-91.

title: 地铁调度案例 02-92：列车间隔表的开门时间超标
summary: 地铁调度第 02-92 号案例。现场反馈的是开门时间超标，排查后定位到列车间隔表与客流闸机的配合方式。处理办法是给加开车固定了占用窗口，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 开门时间超标当周清零（案例 02-92）。
learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 02-92。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 02-92: door dwell overrun on the headway table
en.summary: Case 02-92 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was door dwell overrun, traced to how the headway table interacts with the passenger gate. We fixed an occupancy window for extra trains and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: door dwell overruns fell to zero that week (case 02-92).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 02-92.

title: 冷链物流案例 02-93：冷藏箱体的预冷不足

en.summary: Case 02-93 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was insufficient pre-cooling, traced to how the refrigerated container interacts with the temperature logger.
