learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 17-05。

en.title: PV plant operations case 17-05: unsuitable cleaning cycle on the tilt mount
en.summary: Case 17-05 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was unsuitable cleaning cycle, traced to how the tilt mount interacts with the daily generation report. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 17-05).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 17-05.

title: 图书借阅案例 17-06：逾期通知的密集书库取书慢
summary: 图书借阅第 17-06 号案例。现场反馈的是密集书库取书慢，排查后定位到逾期通知与密集书库的配合方式。处理办法是把密集书库取书按区块批量化，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 预约平均等待从 11 天降到 4 天（案例 17-06）。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 17-06。

en.title: Library lending case 17-06: slow retrieval from compact stacks on the overdue notice
en.summary: Case 17-06 in Library lending. The reported problem was slow retrieval from compact stacks, traced to how the overdue notice interacts with the compact stacks. We batched compact-stack retrieval by block and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 17-06).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 17-06.

title: 水产养殖案例 17-07：增氧机的投饵过量
summary: 水产养殖第 17-07 号案例。现场反馈的是投饵过量，排查后定位到增氧机与投饵机的配合方式。处理办法是按体重重算投饵率，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 17-07）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 17-07。

en.title: Aquaculture case 17-07: overfeeding on the aerator
en.summary: Case 17-07 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was overfeeding, traced to how the aerator interacts with the feeder. We recomputed feeding rate by body weight and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 17-07).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 17-07.

title: 城市停车案例 17-08：车位诱导屏的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 17-08 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到车位诱导屏与高位视频桩的配合方式。处理办法是把诱导屏刷新从 5 分钟改成 30 秒，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 17-08）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 17-08。

en.title: Urban parking case 17-08: stale guidance data on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 17-08 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 17-08).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 17-08.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 17-09：出餐口的配菜表与实际不符
summary: 餐饮出餐第 17-09 号案例。现场反馈的是配菜表与实际不符，排查后定位到出餐口与备餐台的配合方式。处理办法是给叫号屏加了重复提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。写清为什么这次没有沿用去年的方案。算过一遍会不会超出现有产能。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 17-09）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 17-09。

en.title: Restaurant service case 17-09: prep sheet mismatch on the service window
en.summary: Case 17-09 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep sheet mismatch, traced to how the service window interacts with the prep counter. We added repeat prompts to the number screen and re-measured at the same site. We wrote down why last year's plan was not reused. We worked out whether it would exceed current capacity.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 17-09).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 17-09.

title: 农田灌溉案例 17-10：土壤湿度探头的过滤器堵塞频繁
summary: 农田灌溉第 17-10 号案例。现场反馈的是过滤器堵塞频繁，排查后定位到土壤湿度探头与首部过滤器的配合方式。处理办法是把轮次表按地块高差重排了一遍，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 17-10）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 17-10。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 17-10: frequent filter clogging on the soil moisture probe
en.summary: Case 17-10 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was frequent filter clogging, traced to how the soil moisture probe interacts with the head filter. We reordered the rotation table by plot elevation and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 17-10).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 17-10.

title: 医院排班案例 17-11：科室人力池的节假日缺口
summary: 医院排班第 17-11 号案例。现场反馈的是节假日缺口，排查后定位到科室人力池与加班台账的配合方式。处理办法是给换班链加了闭环检查，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 17-11）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 17-11。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 17-11: holiday shortfall on the department staffing pool
en.summary: Case 17-11 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was holiday shortfall, traced to how the department staffing pool interacts with the overtime ledger. We added a closed-loop check to swap chains and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 17-11).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 17-11.

title: 地铁调度案例 17-12：列车间隔表的闸机限流不及时
summary: 地铁调度第 17-12 号案例。现场反馈的是闸机限流不及时，排查后定位到列车间隔表与客流闸机的配合方式。处理办法是按站间实际运行时分重算间隔表，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 折返作业时间从 142 秒压到 118 秒（案例 17-12）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 17-12。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 17-12: late gate throttling on the headway table
en.summary: Case 17-12 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was late gate throttling, traced to how the headway table interacts with the passenger gate. We recomputed the headway table from measured section times and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 17-12).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 17-12.

title: 冷链物流案例 17-13：温度记录仪的记录仪掉点
summary: 冷链物流第 17-13 号案例。现场反馈的是记录仪掉点，排查后定位到温度记录仪与装卸月台的配合方式。处理办法是把记录仪采样从 5 分钟改成 1 分钟，并在同一地点复测确认。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。估算用的模型没考虑季节项。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 17-13）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 17-13。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 17-13: logger data gaps on the temperature logger
en.summary: Case 17-13 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was logger data gaps, traced to how the temperature logger interacts with the loading dock. We changed logger sampling from 5 minutes to 1 minute and re-measured at the same site. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way. The estimation model left out the seasonal term.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 17-13).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 17-13.

title: 快递分拣案例 17-14：格口分配表的返流比例升高
summary: 快递分拣第 17-14 号案例。现场反馈的是返流比例升高，排查后定位到格口分配表与面单识别相机的配合方式。处理办法是把相机曝光改成按面单反光自适应，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 17-14。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 17-14: rising recirculation ratio on the chute allocation table
en.summary: Case 17-14 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was rising recirculation ratio, traced to how the chute allocation table interacts with the label camera. We made camera exposure adaptive to label glare and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: label recognition recovered from 93.5% to 99.1% (case 17-14).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 17-14.

title: 光伏运维案例 17-15：汇流箱的日报口径不一致
summary: 光伏运维第 17-15 号案例。现场反馈的是日报口径不一致，排查后定位到汇流箱与清洗机器人的配合方式。处理办法是让清洗周期跟着积灰速率走，并在同一地点复测确认。算过一遍会不会超出现有产能。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 17-15）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 17-15。

en.title: PV plant operations case 17-15: inconsistent report definitions on the combiner box
en.summary: Case 17-15 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was inconsistent report definitions, traced to how the combiner box interacts with the cleaning robot. We tied the cleaning cycle to dust accumulation rate and re-measured at the same site. We worked out whether it would exceed current capacity.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 17-15).

title: 图书借阅案例 17-16：密集书库的索书号错架
summary: 图书借阅第 17-16 号案例。现场反馈的是索书号错架，排查后定位到密集书库与自助借还机的配合方式。处理办法是给预约队列加了到馆时限，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 逾期通知送达率从 82% 升到 99%（案例 17-16）。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 17-16。

en.title: Library lending case 17-16: misshelved call numbers on the compact stacks
en.summary: Case 17-16 in Library lending. The reported problem was misshelved call numbers, traced to how the compact stacks interacts with the self-service kiosk. We added a pickup deadline to the reservation queue and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: overdue notice delivery rose from 82% to 99% (case 17-16).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 17-16.

title: 水产养殖案例 17-17：水质探头的分池应激
summary: 水产养殖第 17-17 号案例。现场反馈的是分池应激，排查后定位到水质探头与循环水滤床的配合方式。处理办法是把增氧机改成按溶氧闭环启停，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 17-17。

en.title: Aquaculture case 17-17: partitioning stress on the water quality probe
en.summary: Case 17-17 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was partitioning stress, traced to how the water quality probe interacts with the recirculating filter bed. We switched aerators to closed-loop dissolved-oxygen control and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: feed coefficient fell from 1.62 to 1.28 (case 17-17).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 17-17.

title: 城市停车案例 17-18：包月名单的包月名单过期
summary: 城市停车第 17-18 号案例。现场反馈的是包月名单过期，排查后定位到包月名单与错峰共享车位的配合方式。处理办法是把识别结果加了二次比对，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 共享车位周转率提高一倍（案例 17-18）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 17-18。

en.title: Urban parking case 17-18: expired pass list on the monthly pass list
en.summary: Case 17-18 in Urban parking. The reported problem was expired pass list, traced to how the monthly pass list interacts with the off-peak shared bay. We added a second comparison to plate results and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: shared bay turnover doubled (case 17-18).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 17-18.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 17-19：出餐口的叫号漏叫
summary: 餐饮出餐第 17-19 号案例。现场反馈的是叫号漏叫，排查后定位到出餐口与备餐台的配合方式。处理办法是把备餐台按冷热分区，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 17-19。

en.title: Restaurant service case 17-19: missed calls on the service window
en.summary: Case 17-19 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was missed calls, traced to how the service window interacts with the prep counter. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: missed-call rate fell from 5.1% to 0.4% (case 17-19).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 17-19.

title: 农田灌溉案例 17-20：田间气象站的轮次冲突
summary: 农田灌溉第 17-20 号案例。现场反馈的是轮次冲突，排查后定位到田间气象站与干管阀组的配合方式。处理办法是把反冲洗周期改成按压差触发，并在同一地点复测确认。

learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 17-20。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 17-20: rotation conflicts on the field weather station
en.summary: Case 17-20 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was rotation conflicts, traced to how the field weather station interacts with the main valve group. We switched backwash to differential-pressure triggering and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: tail pressure recovered from 0.12 MPa to 0.19 MPa (case 17-20).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 17-20.

title: 医院排班案例 17-21：加班台账的换班链断裂
summary: 医院排班第 17-21 号案例。现场反馈的是换班链断裂，排查后定位到加班台账与夜班组的配合方式。处理办法是给换班链加了闭环检查，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 17-21）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 17-21。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 17-21: broken swap chain on the overtime ledger
en.summary: Case 17-21 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the overtime ledger interacts with the night shift group. We added a closed-loop check to swap chains and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 17-21).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 17-21.

title: 地铁调度案例 17-22：客流闸机的折返效率下降
summary: 地铁调度第 17-22 号案例。现场反馈的是折返效率下降，排查后定位到客流闸机与早高峰加开车的配合方式。处理办法是把折返作业拆成两段并行，并在同一地点复测确认。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。

learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 17-22。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 17-22: turnback efficiency drop on the passenger gate
en.summary: Case 17-22 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was turnback efficiency drop, traced to how the passenger gate interacts with the peak extra train. We split the turnback into two parallel phases and re-measured at the same site. We had to judge whether the weather made it a one-off.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 17-22).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 17-22.

title: 冷链物流案例 17-23：冷藏箱体的预冷不足
summary: 冷链物流第 17-23 号案例。现场反馈的是预冷不足，排查后定位到冷藏箱体与温度记录仪的配合方式。处理办法是把预冷时长按品类分档，并在同一地点复测确认。

learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 17-23。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 17-23: insufficient pre-cooling on the refrigerated container
en.summary: Case 17-23 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was insufficient pre-cooling, traced to how the refrigerated container interacts with the temperature logger. We tiered pre-cooling time by product category and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 17-23).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 17-23.

title: 快递分拣案例 17-24：异形件通道的交叉带打滑
summary: 快递分拣第 17-24 号案例。现场反馈的是交叉带打滑，排查后定位到异形件通道与返流皮带的配合方式。处理办法是在入口加了异形件预分流，并在同一地点复测确认。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 17-24。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 17-24: cross-belt slippage on the irregular-item lane
en.summary: Case 17-24 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was cross-belt slippage, traced to how the irregular-item lane interacts with the recirculation belt. en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 17-24.

summary: 光伏运维第 17-25 号案例。现场反馈的是汇流箱温升，排查后定位到发电量日报与组串逆变器的配合方式。处理办法是让清洗周期跟着积灰速率走，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。

learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 17-25。

en.title: PV plant operations case 17-25: combiner box temperature rise on the daily generation report
en.summary: Case 17-25 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the daily generation report interacts with the string inverter. We tied the cleaning cycle to dust accumulation rate and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 17-25).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 17-25.

title: 图书借阅案例 17-26：自助借还机的借还机识别失败

en.title: Library lending case 17-26: kiosk read failures on the self-service kiosk
en.summary: Case 17-26 in Library lending. The reported problem was kiosk read failures, traced to how the self-service kiosk interacts with the call number. We reordered shelf-reading by floor and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: overdue notice delivery rose from 82% to 99% (case 17-26).

title: 水产养殖案例 17-27：分池网箱的投饵过量
summary: 水产养殖第 17-27 号案例。现场反馈的是投饵过量，排查后定位到分池网箱与增氧机的配合方式。处理办法是把增氧机改成按溶氧闭环启停，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。

en.title: Aquaculture case 17-27: overfeeding on the partition net cage
en.summary: Case 17-27 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was overfeeding, traced to how the partition net cage interacts with the aerator. We switched aerators to closed-loop dissolved-oxygen control and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 17-27).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 17-27.

title: 城市停车案例 17-28：道闸的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 17-28 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到道闸与车位诱导屏的配合方式。处理办法是把诱导屏刷新从 5 分钟改成 30 秒，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 17-28）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 17-28。

en.title: Urban parking case 17-28: stale guidance data on the barrier gate
en.summary: Case 17-28 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the barrier gate interacts with the guidance screen. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 17-28).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 17-28.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 17-29：外卖打包区的出餐乱序
summary: 餐饮出餐第 17-29 号案例。现场反馈的是出餐乱序，排查后定位到外卖打包区与高峰配菜表的配合方式。处理办法是把出餐改成按下单时间强排序，并在同一地点复测确认。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 17-29。

en.title: Restaurant service case 17-29: out-of-order service on the takeaway packing area
en.summary: Case 17-29 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the takeaway packing area interacts with the peak prep sheet. We forced service order by order time and re-measured at the same site. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: missed-call rate fell from 5.1% to 0.4% (case 17-29).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 17-29.

title: 农田灌溉案例 17-30：土壤湿度探头的雨后误启动
summary: 农田灌溉第 17-30 号案例。现场反馈的是雨后误启动，排查后定位到土壤湿度探头与首部过滤器的配合方式。处理办法是把轮次表按地块高差重排了一遍，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。估算用的模型没考虑季节项。
outcome: 反冲洗次数每天从 9 次降到 3 次（案例 17-30）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 17-30。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 17-30: false start after rain on the soil moisture probe
en.summary: Case 17-30 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was false start after rain, traced to how the soil moisture probe interacts with the head filter. We reordered the rotation table by plot elevation and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise. The estimation model left out the seasonal term.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 17-30).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 17-30.

title: 医院排班案例 17-31：加班台账的人力池调用越界
summary: 医院排班第 17-31 号案例。现场反馈的是人力池调用越界，排查后定位到加班台账与夜班组的配合方式。处理办法是给换班链加了闭环检查，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 17-31）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 17-31。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 17-31: out-of-scope pool borrowing on the overtime ledger
en.summary: Case 17-31 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was out-of-scope pool borrowing, traced to how the overtime ledger interacts with the night shift group. We added a closed-loop check to swap chains and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 17-31).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 17-31.

title: 地铁调度案例 17-32：站台屏蔽门的间隔波动
summary: 地铁调度第 17-32 号案例。现场反馈的是间隔波动，排查后定位到站台屏蔽门与折返线的配合方式。处理办法是让闸机限流跟着站台密度走，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。
outcome: 开门时间超标当周清零（案例 17-32）。
learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 17-32。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 17-32: headway jitter on the platform screen door
en.summary: Case 17-32 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was headway jitter, traced to how the platform screen door interacts with the turnback track. We tied gate throttling to platform density and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed.
en.outcome: door dwell overruns fell to zero that week (case 17-32).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 17-32.

title: 冷链物流案例 17-33：干冰配额表的预冷不足
summary: 冷链物流第 17-33 号案例。现场反馈的是预冷不足，排查后定位到干冰配额表与冷藏箱体的配合方式。处理办法是把记录仪采样从 5 分钟改成 1 分钟，并在同一地点复测确认。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 17-33: insufficient pre-cooling on the dry ice quota table
en.summary: Case 17-33 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was insufficient pre-cooling, traced to how the dry ice quota table interacts with the refrigerated container. We changed logger sampling from 5 minutes to 1 minute and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 17-33).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 17-33.

title: 快递分拣案例 17-34：返流皮带的面单识别率下降
summary: 快递分拣第 17-34 号案例。现场反馈的是面单识别率下降，排查后定位到返流皮带与交叉带分拣机的配合方式。处理办法是把相机曝光改成按面单反光自适应，并在同一地点复测确认。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 17-34: label recognition drop on the recirculation belt
en.summary: Case 17-34 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was label recognition drop, traced to how the recirculation belt interacts with the cross-belt sorter. We made camera exposure adaptive to label glare and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 17-34).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 17-34.

title: 光伏运维案例 17-35：组串逆变器的汇流箱温升
summary: 光伏运维第 17-35 号案例。现场反馈的是汇流箱温升，排查后定位到组串逆变器与汇流箱的配合方式。处理办法是按组串电流分布重新分组，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 17-35）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 17-35。

en.title: PV plant operations case 17-35: combiner box temperature rise on the string inverter
en.summary: Case 17-35 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the string inverter interacts with the combiner box. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 17-35).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 17-35.

title: 图书借阅案例 17-36：书目索书号的索书号错架
summary: 图书借阅第 17-36 号案例。现场反馈的是索书号错架，排查后定位到书目索书号与预约队列的配合方式。处理办法是给预约队列加了到馆时限，并在同一地点复测确认。补了一条什么时候该人工介入的判断标准。
outcome: 逾期通知送达率从 82% 升到 99%（案例 17-36）。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 17-36。

en.title: Library lending case 17-36: misshelved call numbers on the call number
en.summary: Case 17-36 in Library lending. The reported problem was misshelved call numbers, traced to how the call number interacts with the reservation queue. We added a pickup deadline to the reservation queue and re-measured at the same site. We added a rule for when a human should step in.
en.outcome: overdue notice delivery rose from 82% to 99% (case 17-36).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 17-36.

title: 水产养殖案例 17-37：水质探头的分池应激
summary: 水产养殖第 17-37 号案例。现场反馈的是分池应激，排查后定位到水质探头与循环水滤床的配合方式。处理办法是按体重重算投饵率，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 17-37）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 17-37。

en.title: Aquaculture case 17-37: partitioning stress on the water quality probe
en.summary: Case 17-37 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was partitioning stress, traced to how the water quality probe interacts with the recirculating filter bed. We recomputed feeding rate by body weight and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 17-37).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 17-37.

title: 城市停车案例 17-38：车位诱导屏的共享车位被长期占用
summary: 城市停车第 17-38 号案例。现场反馈的是共享车位被长期占用，排查后定位到车位诱导屏与高位视频桩的配合方式。处理办法是把识别结果加了二次比对，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 17-38）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 17-38。

en.title: Urban parking case 17-38: shared bays held long-term on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 17-38 in Urban parking. The reported problem was shared bays held long-term, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We added a second comparison to plate results and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 17-38).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 17-38.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 17-39：外卖打包区的配菜表与实际不符
summary: 餐饮出餐第 17-39 号案例。现场反馈的是配菜表与实际不符，排查后定位到外卖打包区与高峰配菜表的配合方式。处理办法是把外卖产能单独留了两个灶口，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 17-39）。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 17-39。

en.title: Restaurant service case 17-39: prep sheet mismatch on the takeaway packing area
en.summary: Case 17-39 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep sheet mismatch, traced to how the takeaway packing area interacts with the peak prep sheet. We reserved two burners for takeaway capacity and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 17-39).
en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 17-39.

title: 农田灌溉案例 17-40：干管阀组的探头读数漂移
summary: 农田灌溉第 17-40 号案例。现场反馈的是探头读数漂移，排查后定位到干管阀组与土壤湿度探头的配合方式。处理办法是在首部加了旁通，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 末端压力从 0.12 兆帕回到 0.19 兆帕（案例 17-40）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 17-40。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 17-40: probe reading drift on the main valve group
en.summary: Case 17-40 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was probe reading drift, traced to how the main valve group interacts with the soil moisture probe. We added a bypass at the head and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: tail pressure recovered from 0.12 MPa to 0.19 MPa (case 17-40).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 17-40.

title: 医院排班案例 17-41：夜班组的连班超时
summary: 医院排班第 17-41 号案例。现场反馈的是连班超时，排查后定位到夜班组与值班表模板的配合方式。处理办法是把人力池按科室分层，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 17-41）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 17-41。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 17-41: back-to-back shift overrun on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 17-41 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was back-to-back shift overrun, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We tiered the staffing pool by department and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 17-41).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 17-41.

title: 地铁调度案例 17-42：折返线的折返效率下降

learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 17-42。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 17-42: turnback efficiency drop on the turnback track
en.summary: Case 17-42 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was turnback efficiency drop, traced to how the turnback track interacts with the headway table. We split the turnback into two parallel phases and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 17-42).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 17-42.

title: 冷链物流案例 17-43：干冰配额表的记录仪掉点

learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 17-43。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 17-43: logger data gaps on the dry ice quota table
en.summary: Case 17-43 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was logger data gaps, traced to how the dry ice quota table interacts with the refrigerated container. We tiered pre-cooling time by product category and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 17-43).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 17-43.

title: 快递分拣案例 17-44：返流皮带的异形件误入主线
summary: 快递分拣第 17-44 号案例。现场反馈的是异形件误入主线，排查后定位到返流皮带与交叉带分拣机的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 17-44: irregular items entering the main line on the recirculation belt
en.summary: Case 17-44 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was irregular items entering the main line, traced to how the recirculation belt interacts with the cross-belt sorter. en.summary: Case 17-45 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was seasonal tilt deviation, traced to how the combiner box interacts with the cleaning robot.
