en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 42-77).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 42-77.

title: 城市停车案例 42-78：道闸的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 42-78 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到道闸与车位诱导屏的配合方式。处理办法是让包月名单按天同步，并在同一地点复测确认。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 42-78）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 42-78。

en.title: Urban parking case 42-78: stale guidance data on the barrier gate
en.summary: Case 42-78 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the barrier gate interacts with the guidance screen. We synced the pass list daily and re-measured at the same site. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 42-78).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 42-78.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 42-79：出餐口的配菜表与实际不符
summary: 餐饮出餐第 42-79 号案例。现场反馈的是配菜表与实际不符，排查后定位到出餐口与备餐台的配合方式。处理办法是把出餐改成按下单时间强排序，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 42-79）。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 42-79。

en.title: Restaurant service case 42-79: prep sheet mismatch on the service window
en.summary: Case 42-79 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep sheet mismatch, traced to how the service window interacts with the prep counter. We forced service order by order time and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 42-79).
en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 42-79.

title: 农田灌溉案例 42-80：首部过滤器的雨后误启动
summary: 农田灌溉第 42-80 号案例。现场反馈的是雨后误启动，排查后定位到首部过滤器与轮灌轮次表的配合方式。处理办法是在首部加了旁通，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 轮次冲突当季清零（案例 42-80）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 42-80。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 42-80: false start after rain on the head filter
en.summary: Case 42-80 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was false start after rain, traced to how the head filter interacts with the rotation table. We added a bypass at the head and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: rotation conflicts fell to zero for the season (case 42-80).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 42-80.

title: 医院排班案例 42-81：夜班组的节假日缺口
summary: 医院排班第 42-81 号案例。现场反馈的是节假日缺口，排查后定位到夜班组与值班表模板的配合方式。处理办法是给换班链加了闭环检查，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 42-81）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 42-81。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 42-81: holiday shortfall on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 42-81 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was holiday shortfall, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We added a closed-loop check to swap chains and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 42-81).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 42-81.

title: 地铁调度案例 42-82：客流闸机的开门时间超标
summary: 地铁调度第 42-82 号案例。现场反馈的是开门时间超标，排查后定位到客流闸机与早高峰加开车的配合方式。处理办法是把折返作业拆成两段并行，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 折返作业时间从 142 秒压到 118 秒（案例 42-82）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 42-82。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 42-82: door dwell overrun on the passenger gate
en.summary: Case 42-82 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was door dwell overrun, traced to how the passenger gate interacts with the peak extra train. We split the turnback into two parallel phases and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 42-82).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 42-82.

title: 冷链物流案例 42-83：装卸月台的记录仪掉点
summary: 冷链物流第 42-83 号案例。现场反馈的是记录仪掉点，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是给月台加了风幕并改了作业顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 42-83）。
learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 42-83。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 42-83: logger data gaps on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 42-83 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was logger data gaps, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We added an air curtain and reordered dock operations and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 42-83).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 42-83.

title: 快递分拣案例 42-84：交叉带分拣机的异形件误入主线
summary: 快递分拣第 42-84 号案例。现场反馈的是异形件误入主线，排查后定位到交叉带分拣机与格口分配表的配合方式。处理办法是把返流皮带速度与主线解耦，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 42-84。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 42-84: irregular items entering the main line on the cross-belt sorter
en.summary: Case 42-84 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was irregular items entering the main line, traced to how the cross-belt sorter interacts with the chute allocation table. We decoupled recirculation belt speed from the main line and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 42-84).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 42-84.
concepts: irregular items entering the main line

title: 光伏运维案例 42-85：清洗机器人的日报口径不一致
summary: 光伏运维第 42-85 号案例。现场反馈的是日报口径不一致，排查后定位到清洗机器人与倾角支架的配合方式。处理办法是按组串电流分布重新分组，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。
outcome: 组串失配损失从 4.1% 降到 1.3%（案例 42-85）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 42-85。

en.title: PV plant operations case 42-85: inconsistent report definitions on the cleaning robot
en.summary: Case 42-85 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was inconsistent report definitions, traced to how the cleaning robot interacts with the tilt mount. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 42-85).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 42-85.

title: 图书借阅案例 42-86：预约队列的预约队列超长
summary: 图书借阅第 42-86 号案例。现场反馈的是预约队列超长，排查后定位到预约队列与逾期通知的配合方式。处理办法是把逾期通知改成三段提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 42-86。

en.title: Library lending case 42-86: over-long reservation queue on the reservation queue
en.summary: Case 42-86 in Library lending. The reported problem was over-long reservation queue, traced to how the reservation queue interacts with the overdue notice. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 42-86).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 42-86.

title: 水产养殖案例 42-87：水质探头的分池应激
summary: 水产养殖第 42-87 号案例。现场反馈的是分池应激，排查后定位到水质探头与循环水滤床的配合方式。处理办法是把增氧机改成按溶氧闭环启停，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 42-87）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 42-87。

en.title: Aquaculture case 42-87: partitioning stress on the water quality probe
en.summary: Case 42-87 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was partitioning stress, traced to how the water quality probe interacts with the recirculating filter bed. We switched aerators to closed-loop dissolved-oxygen control and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 42-87).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 42-87.

title: 城市停车案例 42-88：道闸的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 42-88 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到道闸与车位诱导屏的配合方式。处理办法是把诱导屏刷新从 5 分钟改成 30 秒，并在同一地点复测确认。预测用的模型换过一次参数，口径随之更新。
outcome: 共享车位周转率提高一倍（案例 42-88）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 42-88。

en.title: Urban parking case 42-88: stale guidance data on the barrier gate
en.summary: Case 42-88 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the barrier gate interacts with the guidance screen. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site. The forecasting model had its parameters changed once, and the metric definition followed.
en.outcome: shared bay turnover doubled (case 42-88).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 42-88.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 42-89：备餐台的叫号漏叫
summary: 餐饮出餐第 42-89 号案例。现场反馈的是叫号漏叫，排查后定位到备餐台与叫号屏的配合方式。处理办法是给叫号屏加了重复提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 42-89）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 42-89。

en.title: Restaurant service case 42-89: missed calls on the prep counter
en.summary: Case 42-89 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was missed calls, traced to how the prep counter interacts with the number screen. We added repeat prompts to the number screen and re-measured at the same site. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 42-89).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 42-89.

title: 农田灌溉案例 42-90：土壤湿度探头的末端压力不足
summary: 农田灌溉第 42-90 号案例。现场反馈的是末端压力不足，排查后定位到土壤湿度探头与首部过滤器的配合方式。处理办法是把反冲洗周期改成按压差触发，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。
outcome: 轮次冲突当季清零（案例 42-90）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 42-90。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 42-90: insufficient tail pressure on the soil moisture probe
en.summary: Case 42-90 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was insufficient tail pressure, traced to how the soil moisture probe interacts with the head filter. We switched backwash to differential-pressure triggering and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise.
en.outcome: rotation conflicts fell to zero for the season (case 42-90).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 42-90.

title: 医院排班案例 42-91：值班表模板的台账与打卡不符
summary: 医院排班第 42-91 号案例。现场反馈的是台账与打卡不符，排查后定位到值班表模板与换班申请单的配合方式。处理办法是把节假日缺口提前四周预警，并在同一地点复测确认。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。写明什么时候可以跳过复核。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 42-91）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 42-91。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 42-91: ledger and clock-in mismatch on the roster template
en.summary: Case 42-91 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was ledger and clock-in mismatch, traced to how the roster template interacts with the swap request form. We raised holiday shortfall alerts four weeks ahead and re-measured at the same site. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way. We spelled out when the review can be skipped.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 42-91).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 42-91.

title: 地铁调度案例 42-92：折返线的开门时间超标
summary: 地铁调度第 42-92 号案例。现场反馈的是开门时间超标，排查后定位到折返线与列车间隔表的配合方式。处理办法是给加开车固定了占用窗口，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 开门时间超标当周清零（案例 42-92）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 42-92。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 42-92: door dwell overrun on the turnback track
en.summary: Case 42-92 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was door dwell overrun, traced to how the turnback track interacts with the headway table. We fixed an occupancy window for extra trains and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: door dwell overruns fell to zero that week (case 42-92).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 42-92.

title: 冷链物流案例 42-93：装卸月台的箱门密封失效
summary: 冷链物流第 42-93 号案例。现场反馈的是箱门密封失效，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是把记录仪采样从 5 分钟改成 1 分钟，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 月台温升从 6.5 摄氏度降到 2.1 摄氏度（案例 42-93）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 42-93。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 42-93: door seal failure on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 42-93 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was door seal failure, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We changed logger sampling from 5 minutes to 1 minute and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 42-93).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 42-93.

title: 快递分拣案例 42-94：面单识别相机的面单识别率下降
summary: 快递分拣第 42-94 号案例。现场反馈的是面单识别率下降，排查后定位到面单识别相机与异形件通道的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。写明什么时候可以跳过复核。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 42-94。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 42-94: label recognition drop on the label camera
en.summary: Case 42-94 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was label recognition drop, traced to how the label camera interacts with the irregular-item lane. We reordered chute allocation by destination flow and re-measured at the same site. We spelled out when the review can be skipped.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 42-94).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 42-94.

title: 光伏运维案例 42-95：发电量日报的倾角季节性偏差
summary: 光伏运维第 42-95 号案例。现场反馈的是倾角季节性偏差，排查后定位到发电量日报与组串逆变器的配合方式。处理办法是按季节调了两次倾角，并在同一地点复测确认。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。排产用的模型只按历史均值走，遇到突发就偏。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 42-95）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 42-95。

en.title: PV plant operations case 42-95: seasonal tilt deviation on the daily generation report
en.summary: Case 42-95 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was seasonal tilt deviation, traced to how the daily generation report interacts with the string inverter. We adjusted tilt twice by season and re-measured at the same site. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one. The scheduling model follows historical averages only and drifts under sudden load.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 42-95).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 42-95.

title: 图书借阅案例 42-96：预约队列的索书号错架
summary: 图书借阅第 42-96 号案例。现场反馈的是索书号错架，排查后定位到预约队列与逾期通知的配合方式。处理办法是把密集书库取书按区块批量化，并在同一地点复测确认。上线前评估过会不会影响夜间作业。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 42-96。

en.title: Library lending case 42-96: misshelved call numbers on the reservation queue
en.summary: Case 42-96 in Library lending. The reported problem was misshelved call numbers, traced to how the reservation queue interacts with the overdue notice. We batched compact-stack retrieval by block and re-measured at the same site. Before rollout we assessed whether night operations would be affected.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 42-96).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 42-96.

title: 水产养殖案例 42-97：投饵机的分池应激
summary: 水产养殖第 42-97 号案例。现场反馈的是分池应激，排查后定位到投饵机与水质探头的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。估算用的模型没考虑季节项。
outcome: 夜间最低溶氧从 2.1 毫克每升升到 4.3 毫克每升（案例 42-97）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 42-97。

en.title: Aquaculture case 42-97: partitioning stress on the feeder
en.summary: Case 42-97 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was partitioning stress, traced to how the feeder interacts with the water quality probe. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site. The estimation model left out the seasonal term.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 42-97).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 42-97.

title: 城市停车案例 42-98：包月名单的共享车位被长期占用
summary: 城市停车第 42-98 号案例。现场反馈的是共享车位被长期占用，排查后定位到包月名单与错峰共享车位的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。
outcome: 共享车位周转率提高一倍（案例 42-98）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 42-98。

en.title: Urban parking case 42-98: shared bays held long-term on the monthly pass list
