outcome: 格口爆仓每班从 7 次降到 1 次（案例 54-14）。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 54-14。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 54-14: chute overflow on the chute allocation table
en.summary: Case 54-14 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was chute overflow, traced to how the chute allocation table interacts with the label camera. We made camera exposure adaptive to label glare and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed.
en.outcome: chute overflows per shift fell from 7 to 1 (case 54-14).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 54-14.

title: 光伏运维案例 54-15：组串逆变器的清洗周期不合理
summary: 光伏运维第 54-15 号案例。现场反馈的是清洗周期不合理，排查后定位到组串逆变器与汇流箱的配合方式。处理办法是让清洗周期跟着积灰速率走，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。

en.title: PV plant operations case 54-15: unsuitable cleaning cycle on the string inverter
en.summary: Case 54-15 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was unsuitable cleaning cycle, traced to how the string inverter interacts with the combiner box. We tied the cleaning cycle to dust accumulation rate and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 54-15).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 54-15.

title: 图书借阅案例 54-16：逾期通知的预约队列超长
summary: 图书借阅第 54-16 号案例。现场反馈的是预约队列超长，排查后定位到逾期通知与密集书库的配合方式。处理办法是按楼层重排索书号巡架顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 逾期通知送达率从 82% 升到 99%（案例 54-16）。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 54-16。

en.title: Library lending case 54-16: over-long reservation queue on the overdue notice
en.summary: Case 54-16 in Library lending. The reported problem was over-long reservation queue, traced to how the overdue notice interacts with the compact stacks. We reordered shelf-reading by floor and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: overdue notice delivery rose from 82% to 99% (case 54-16).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 54-16.

title: 水产养殖案例 54-17：投饵机的分池应激
summary: 水产养殖第 54-17 号案例。现场反馈的是分池应激，排查后定位到投饵机与水质探头的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 夜间最低溶氧从 2.1 毫克每升升到 4.3 毫克每升（案例 54-17）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 54-17。

en.title: Aquaculture case 54-17: partitioning stress on the feeder
en.summary: Case 54-17 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was partitioning stress, traced to how the feeder interacts with the water quality probe. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 54-17).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 54-17.

title: 城市停车案例 54-18：包月名单的包月名单过期
summary: 城市停车第 54-18 号案例。现场反馈的是包月名单过期，排查后定位到包月名单与错峰共享车位的配合方式。处理办法是让包月名单按天同步，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。
outcome: 共享车位周转率提高一倍（案例 54-18）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 54-18。

en.title: Urban parking case 54-18: expired pass list on the monthly pass list
en.summary: Case 54-18 in Urban parking. The reported problem was expired pass list, traced to how the monthly pass list interacts with the off-peak shared bay. We synced the pass list daily and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed.
en.outcome: shared bay turnover doubled (case 54-18).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 54-18.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 54-19：高峰配菜表的备餐台拥堵

outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 54-19）。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 54-19。

en.title: Restaurant service case 54-19: prep counter congestion on the peak prep sheet
en.summary: Case 54-19 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep counter congestion, traced to how the peak prep sheet interacts with the service window. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 54-19).
en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 54-19.

title: 农田灌溉案例 54-20：干管阀组的过滤器堵塞频繁
summary: 农田灌溉第 54-20 号案例。现场反馈的是过滤器堵塞频繁，排查后定位到干管阀组与土壤湿度探头的配合方式。处理办法是在首部加了旁通，并在同一地点复测确认。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 54-20: frequent filter clogging on the main valve group
en.summary: Case 54-20 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was frequent filter clogging, traced to how the main valve group interacts with the soil moisture probe. We added a bypass at the head and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 54-20).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 54-20.

title: 医院排班案例 54-21：值班表模板的换班链断裂
summary: 医院排班第 54-21 号案例。现场反馈的是换班链断裂，排查后定位到值班表模板与换班申请单的配合方式。处理办法是把连班上限写进模板校验，并在同一地点复测确认。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 54-21）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 54-21。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 54-21: broken swap chain on the roster template
en.summary: Case 54-21 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the roster template interacts with the swap request form. We moved the back-to-back cap into template validation and re-measured at the same site. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 54-21).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 54-21.

title: 地铁调度案例 54-22：客流闸机的折返效率下降

learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 54-22。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 54-22: turnback efficiency drop on the passenger gate
en.summary: Case 54-22 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was turnback efficiency drop, traced to how the passenger gate interacts with the peak extra train. We recomputed the headway table from measured section times and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 54-22).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 54-22.

title: 冷链物流案例 54-23：干冰配额表的记录仪掉点

outcome: 到货温度超标批次当季从 11 批降到 1 批（案例 54-23）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 54-23。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 54-23: logger data gaps on the dry ice quota table
en.summary: Case 54-23 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was logger data gaps, traced to how the dry ice quota table interacts with the refrigerated container. We added an air curtain and reordered dock operations and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware. We added a note on why the earlier criterion did not apply. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: out-of-spec arrival batches fell from 11 to 1 for the season (case 54-23).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 54-23.

title: 快递分拣案例 54-24：面单识别相机的异形件误入主线
summary: 快递分拣第 54-24 号案例。现场反馈的是异形件误入主线，排查后定位到面单识别相机与异形件通道的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 54-24。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 54-24: irregular items entering the main line on the label camera
en.summary: Case 54-24 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was irregular items entering the main line, traced to how the label camera interacts with the irregular-item lane. We reordered chute allocation by destination flow and re-measured at the same site.

title: 光伏运维案例 54-25：倾角支架的日报口径不一致
summary: 光伏运维第 54-25 号案例。现场反馈的是日报口径不一致，排查后定位到倾角支架与发电量日报的配合方式。处理办法是按季节调了两次倾角，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。

en.title: PV plant operations case 54-25: inconsistent report definitions on the tilt mount

en.title: Library lending case 54-26: missed overdue notices on the compact stacks

title: 水产养殖案例 54-27：投饵机的分池应激

en.title: Aquaculture case 54-27: partitioning stress on the feeder
en.summary: Case 54-27 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was partitioning stress, traced to how the feeder interacts with the water quality probe. We recomputed feeding rate by body weight and re-measured at the same site. We added a rule for when a human should step in.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 54-27).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 54-27.

title: 城市停车案例 54-28：高位视频桩的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 54-28 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到高位视频桩与包月名单的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。

en.title: Urban parking case 54-28: stale guidance data on the overhead video pole
en.summary: Case 54-28 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the overhead video pole interacts with the monthly pass list. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 54-28).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 54-28.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 54-29：叫号屏的配菜表与实际不符
summary: 餐饮出餐第 54-29 号案例。现场反馈的是配菜表与实际不符，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是把外卖产能单独留了两个灶口，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。

en.title: Restaurant service case 54-29: prep sheet mismatch on the number screen
en.summary: Case 54-29 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep sheet mismatch, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We reserved two burners for takeaway capacity and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.

title: 农田灌溉案例 54-30：首部过滤器的末端压力不足
summary: 农田灌溉第 54-30 号案例。现场反馈的是末端压力不足，排查后定位到首部过滤器与轮灌轮次表的配合方式。处理办法是把雨量判据从日累计改成小时累计，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。排产用的模型只按历史均值走，遇到突发就偏。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 54-30: insufficient tail pressure on the head filter
en.summary: Case 54-30 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was insufficient tail pressure, traced to how the head filter interacts with the rotation table. We changed the rain criterion from daily to hourly and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover. The scheduling model follows historical averages only and drifts under sudden load.
en.outcome: tail pressure recovered from 0.12 MPa to 0.19 MPa (case 54-30).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 54-30.

title: 医院排班案例 54-31：换班申请单的连班超时
summary: 医院排班第 54-31 号案例。现场反馈的是连班超时，排查后定位到换班申请单与科室人力池的配合方式。处理办法是把连班上限写进模板校验，并在同一地点复测确认。

learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 54-31。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 54-31: back-to-back shift overrun on the swap request form
en.summary: Case 54-31 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was back-to-back shift overrun, traced to how the swap request form interacts with the department staffing pool. We moved the back-to-back cap into template validation and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 54-31).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 54-31.

title: 地铁调度案例 54-32：站台屏蔽门的闸机限流不及时

en.title: Metro dispatching case 54-32: late gate throttling on the platform screen door
en.summary: Case 54-32 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was late gate throttling, traced to how the platform screen door interacts with the turnback track. We recomputed the headway table from measured section times and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 54-32).

learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 54-33。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 54-33: dock temperature rise on the pre-cooling room
en.summary: Case 54-33 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the pre-cooling room interacts with the dry ice quota table. We tiered pre-cooling time by product category and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 54-33).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 54-33.

title: 快递分拣案例 54-34：交叉带分拣机的面单识别率下降
summary: 快递分拣第 54-34 号案例。现场反馈的是面单识别率下降，排查后定位到交叉带分拣机与格口分配表的配合方式。处理办法是把相机曝光改成按面单反光自适应，并在同一地点复测确认。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 格口爆仓每班从 7 次降到 1 次（案例 54-34）。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 54-34: label recognition drop on the cross-belt sorter
en.summary: Case 54-34 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was label recognition drop, traced to how the cross-belt sorter interacts with the chute allocation table. We made camera exposure adaptive to label glare and re-measured at the same site. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: chute overflows per shift fell from 7 to 1 (case 54-34).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 54-34.

title: 光伏运维案例 54-35：发电量日报的汇流箱温升

learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 54-35。

en.title: PV plant operations case 54-35: combiner box temperature rise on the daily generation report
en.summary: Case 54-35 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the daily generation report interacts with the string inverter. We tied the cleaning cycle to dust accumulation rate and re-measured at the same site. We checked whether the previous parameter set had not been synced.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 54-35).

title: 图书借阅案例 54-36：自助借还机的索书号错架
summary: 图书借阅第 54-36 号案例。现场反馈的是索书号错架，排查后定位到自助借还机与书目索书号的配合方式。处理办法是按楼层重排索书号巡架顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。

learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 54-36。

en.title: Library lending case 54-36: misshelved call numbers on the self-service kiosk
en.summary: Case 54-36 in Library lending. The reported problem was misshelved call numbers, traced to how the self-service kiosk interacts with the call number. We reordered shelf-reading by floor and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware. We had to judge whether the weather made it a one-off. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 54-36).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 54-36.

title: 水产养殖案例 54-37：水质探头的滤床短路流
summary: 水产养殖第 54-37 号案例。现场反馈的是滤床短路流，排查后定位到水质探头与循环水滤床的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。

en.title: Aquaculture case 54-37: filter bed short-circuiting on the water quality probe
en.summary: Case 54-37 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the water quality probe interacts with the recirculating filter bed. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site.

en.title: Urban parking case 54-38: shared bays held long-term on the monthly pass list
en.summary: Case 54-38 in Urban parking. The reported problem was shared bays held long-term, traced to how the monthly pass list interacts with the off-peak shared bay. We synced the pass list daily and re-measured at the same site.

en.title: Restaurant service case 54-39: out-of-order service on the number screen
en.summary: Case 54-39 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. summary: 农田灌溉第 54-40 号案例。现场反馈的是过滤器堵塞频繁，排查后定位到田间气象站与干管阀组的配合方式。处理办法是给探头加了两点标定，并在同一地点复测确认。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 54-40: frequent filter clogging on the field weather station
en.summary: Case 54-40 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was frequent filter clogging, traced to how the field weather station interacts with the main valve group. We added two-point calibration to the probe and re-measured at the same site.

learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 54-41。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 54-41: broken swap chain on the roster template
en.summary: Case 54-41 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the roster template interacts with the swap request form. We added a closed-loop check to swap chains and re-measured at the same site. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 54-41).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 54-41.

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 54-43: insufficient pre-cooling on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 54-43 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was insufficient pre-cooling, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We tiered pre-cooling time by product category and re-measured at the same site.

en.summary: Case 54-44 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was cross-belt slippage, traced to how the irregular-item lane interacts with the recirculation belt. en.title: Library lending case 54-66: slow retrieval from compact stacks on the overdue notice
en.summary: Case 54-66 in Library lending. The reported problem was slow retrieval from compact stacks, traced to how the overdue notice interacts with the compact stacks. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. Someone on site asked whether the old procedure could hold for two more days. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest. The estimation model left out the seasonal term.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 54-66).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 54-66.

title: 水产养殖案例 54-67：增氧机的投饵过量
summary: 水产养殖第 54-67 号案例。现场反馈的是投饵过量，排查后定位到增氧机与投饵机的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 54-67。

en.title: Aquaculture case 54-67: overfeeding on the aerator
en.summary: Case 54-67 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was overfeeding, traced to how the aerator interacts with the feeder. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: feed coefficient fell from 1.62 to 1.28 (case 54-67).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 54-67.

title: 城市停车案例 54-68：车位诱导屏的诱导屏数据滞后

outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 54-68）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 54-68。

en.title: Urban parking case 54-68: stale guidance data on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 54-68 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site.

en.summary: Case 54-69 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was takeaway competing with dine-in, traced to how the peak prep sheet interacts with the service window. We reserved two burners for takeaway capacity and re-measured at the same site.
