title: 水产养殖案例 57-17：水质探头的投饵过量
summary: 水产养殖第 57-17 号案例。现场反馈的是投饵过量，排查后定位到水质探头与循环水滤床的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 57-17。

en.title: Aquaculture case 57-17: overfeeding on the water quality probe
en.summary: Case 57-17 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was overfeeding, traced to how the water quality probe interacts with the recirculating filter bed. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: feed coefficient fell from 1.62 to 1.28 (case 57-17).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 57-17.

title: 城市停车案例 57-18：高位视频桩的包月名单过期
summary: 城市停车第 57-18 号案例。现场反馈的是包月名单过期，排查后定位到高位视频桩与包月名单的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。争论点是能不能只改一处就够。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 57-18）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 57-18。

en.title: Urban parking case 57-18: expired pass list on the overhead video pole
en.summary: Case 57-18 in Urban parking. The reported problem was expired pass list, traced to how the overhead video pole interacts with the monthly pass list. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site. The argument was whether changing one place would be enough. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 57-18).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 57-18.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 57-19：叫号屏的出餐乱序
summary: 餐饮出餐第 57-19 号案例。现场反馈的是出餐乱序，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是把备餐台按冷热分区，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 57-19。

en.title: Restaurant service case 57-19: out-of-order service on the number screen
en.summary: Case 57-19 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: missed-call rate fell from 5.1% to 0.4% (case 57-19).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 57-19.

title: 农田灌溉案例 57-20：田间气象站的末端压力不足
summary: 农田灌溉第 57-20 号案例。现场反馈的是末端压力不足，排查后定位到田间气象站与干管阀组的配合方式。处理办法是给探头加了两点标定，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 57-20）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 57-20。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 57-20: insufficient tail pressure on the field weather station
en.summary: Case 57-20 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was insufficient tail pressure, traced to how the field weather station interacts with the main valve group. We added two-point calibration to the probe and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 57-20).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 57-20.

title: 医院排班案例 57-21：换班申请单的节假日缺口
summary: 医院排班第 57-21 号案例。现场反馈的是节假日缺口，排查后定位到换班申请单与科室人力池的配合方式。处理办法是把节假日缺口提前四周预警，并在同一地点复测确认。上线前评估过会不会影响夜间作业。
outcome: 连班超时当月从 14 例降到 0 例（案例 57-21）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 57-21。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 57-21: holiday shortfall on the swap request form
en.summary: Case 57-21 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was holiday shortfall, traced to how the swap request form interacts with the department staffing pool. We raised holiday shortfall alerts four weeks ahead and re-measured at the same site. Before rollout we assessed whether night operations would be affected.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 57-21).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 57-21.

title: 地铁调度案例 57-22：列车间隔表的间隔波动
summary: 地铁调度第 57-22 号案例。现场反馈的是间隔波动，排查后定位到列车间隔表与客流闸机的配合方式。处理办法是把折返作业拆成两段并行，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 开门时间超标当周清零（案例 57-22）。
learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 57-22。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 57-22: headway jitter on the headway table
en.summary: Case 57-22 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was headway jitter, traced to how the headway table interacts with the passenger gate. We split the turnback into two parallel phases and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: door dwell overruns fell to zero that week (case 57-22).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 57-22.

title: 冷链物流案例 57-23：温度记录仪的月台温升
summary: 冷链物流第 57-23 号案例。现场反馈的是月台温升，排查后定位到温度记录仪与装卸月台的配合方式。处理办法是按里程与季节重算干冰配额，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 57-23）。
learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 57-23。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 57-23: dock temperature rise on the temperature logger
en.summary: Case 57-23 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the temperature logger interacts with the loading dock. We recomputed dry ice quota by distance and season and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 57-23).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 57-23.

title: 快递分拣案例 57-24：返流皮带的交叉带打滑
summary: 快递分拣第 57-24 号案例。现场反馈的是交叉带打滑，排查后定位到返流皮带与交叉带分拣机的配合方式。处理办法是在入口加了异形件预分流，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 57-24。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 57-24: cross-belt slippage on the recirculation belt
en.summary: Case 57-24 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was cross-belt slippage, traced to how the recirculation belt interacts with the cross-belt sorter. We added irregular-item pre-diversion at the inlet and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 57-24).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 57-24.

title: 光伏运维案例 57-25：倾角支架的汇流箱温升
summary: 光伏运维第 57-25 号案例。现场反馈的是汇流箱温升，排查后定位到倾角支架与发电量日报的配合方式。处理办法是按季节调了两次倾角，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 组串失配损失从 4.1% 降到 1.3%（案例 57-25）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 57-25。

en.title: PV plant operations case 57-25: combiner box temperature rise on the tilt mount
en.summary: Case 57-25 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the tilt mount interacts with the daily generation report. We adjusted tilt twice by season and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 57-25).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 57-25.

title: 图书借阅案例 57-26：密集书库的预约队列超长
summary: 图书借阅第 57-26 号案例。现场反馈的是预约队列超长，排查后定位到密集书库与自助借还机的配合方式。处理办法是给预约队列加了到馆时限，并在同一地点复测确认。争论点是能不能只改一处就够。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 57-26。

en.title: Library lending case 57-26: over-long reservation queue on the compact stacks
en.summary: Case 57-26 in Library lending. The reported problem was over-long reservation queue, traced to how the compact stacks interacts with the self-service kiosk. We added a pickup deadline to the reservation queue and re-measured at the same site. The argument was whether changing one place would be enough.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 57-26).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 57-26.

title: 水产养殖案例 57-27：循环水滤床的溶氧夜间跌落
summary: 水产养殖第 57-27 号案例。现场反馈的是溶氧夜间跌落，排查后定位到循环水滤床与分池网箱的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。写清为什么这次没有沿用去年的方案。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 57-27）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 57-27。

en.title: Aquaculture case 57-27: night dissolved-oxygen drop on the recirculating filter bed
en.summary: Case 57-27 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was night dissolved-oxygen drop, traced to how the recirculating filter bed interacts with the partition net cage. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site. We wrote down why last year's plan was not reused.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 57-27).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 57-27.

title: 城市停车案例 57-28：错峰共享车位的出场排队
summary: 城市停车第 57-28 号案例。现场反馈的是出场排队，排查后定位到错峰共享车位与道闸的配合方式。处理办法是让包月名单按天同步，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 57-28）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 57-28。

en.title: Urban parking case 57-28: exit queueing on the off-peak shared bay
en.summary: Case 57-28 in Urban parking. The reported problem was exit queueing, traced to how the off-peak shared bay interacts with the barrier gate. We synced the pass list daily and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 57-28).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 57-28.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 57-29：高峰配菜表的外卖与堂食抢产能
summary: 餐饮出餐第 57-29 号案例。现场反馈的是外卖与堂食抢产能，排查后定位到高峰配菜表与出餐口的配合方式。处理办法是把出餐改成按下单时间强排序，并在同一地点复测确认。写清为什么这次没有沿用去年的方案。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 57-29）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 57-29。

en.title: Restaurant service case 57-29: takeaway competing with dine-in on the peak prep sheet
en.summary: Case 57-29 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was takeaway competing with dine-in, traced to how the peak prep sheet interacts with the service window. We forced service order by order time and re-measured at the same site. We wrote down why last year's plan was not reused.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 57-29).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 57-29.

title: 农田灌溉案例 57-30：首部过滤器的末端压力不足
summary: 农田灌溉第 57-30 号案例。现场反馈的是末端压力不足，排查后定位到首部过滤器与轮灌轮次表的配合方式。处理办法是在首部加了旁通，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 反冲洗次数每天从 9 次降到 3 次（案例 57-30）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 57-30。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 57-30: insufficient tail pressure on the head filter
en.summary: Case 57-30 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was insufficient tail pressure, traced to how the head filter interacts with the rotation table. We added a bypass at the head and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 57-30).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 57-30.

title: 医院排班案例 57-31：科室人力池的台账与打卡不符
summary: 医院排班第 57-31 号案例。现场反馈的是台账与打卡不符，排查后定位到科室人力池与加班台账的配合方式。处理办法是把人力池按科室分层，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 57-31）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 57-31。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 57-31: ledger and clock-in mismatch on the department staffing pool
en.summary: Case 57-31 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was ledger and clock-in mismatch, traced to how the department staffing pool interacts with the overtime ledger. We tiered the staffing pool by department and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 57-31).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 57-31.

title: 地铁调度案例 57-32：列车间隔表的闸机限流不及时
summary: 地铁调度第 57-32 号案例。现场反馈的是闸机限流不及时，排查后定位到列车间隔表与客流闸机的配合方式。处理办法是按站间实际运行时分重算间隔表，并在同一地点复测确认。现场问过一句：能不能先按老办法顶两天。
outcome: 早高峰间隔波动从 ±35 秒收到 ±12 秒（案例 57-32）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 57-32。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 57-32: late gate throttling on the headway table
en.summary: Case 57-32 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was late gate throttling, traced to how the headway table interacts with the passenger gate. We recomputed the headway table from measured section times and re-measured at the same site. Someone on site asked whether the old procedure could hold for two more days.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 57-32).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 57-32.

title: 冷链物流案例 57-33：预冷间的箱门密封失效
summary: 冷链物流第 57-33 号案例。现场反馈的是箱门密封失效，排查后定位到预冷间与干冰配额表的配合方式。处理办法是按里程与季节重算干冰配额，并在同一地点复测确认。定了什么时候必须停线检查。
outcome: 月台温升从 6.5 摄氏度降到 2.1 摄氏度（案例 57-33）。
learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 57-33。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 57-33: door seal failure on the pre-cooling room
en.summary: Case 57-33 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was door seal failure, traced to how the pre-cooling room interacts with the dry ice quota table. We recomputed dry ice quota by distance and season and re-measured at the same site. We set when the line must stop for inspection.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 57-33).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 57-33.

title: 快递分拣案例 57-34：交叉带分拣机的返流比例升高
summary: 快递分拣第 57-34 号案例。现场反馈的是返流比例升高，排查后定位到交叉带分拣机与格口分配表的配合方式。处理办法是把返流皮带速度与主线解耦，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 57-34。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 57-34: rising recirculation ratio on the cross-belt sorter
en.summary: Case 57-34 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was rising recirculation ratio, traced to how the cross-belt sorter interacts with the chute allocation table. We decoupled recirculation belt speed from the main line and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 57-34).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 57-34.

title: 光伏运维案例 57-35：发电量日报的日报口径不一致
summary: 光伏运维第 57-35 号案例。现场反馈的是日报口径不一致，排查后定位到发电量日报与组串逆变器的配合方式。处理办法是把汇流箱巡检改成红外筛查，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 组串失配损失从 4.1% 降到 1.3%（案例 57-35）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 57-35。

en.title: PV plant operations case 57-35: inconsistent report definitions on the daily generation report
en.summary: Case 57-35 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was inconsistent report definitions, traced to how the daily generation report interacts with the string inverter. We switched combiner inspection to infrared screening and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 57-35).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 57-35.

title: 图书借阅案例 57-36：自助借还机的索书号错架
summary: 图书借阅第 57-36 号案例。现场反馈的是索书号错架，排查后定位到自助借还机与书目索书号的配合方式。处理办法是给预约队列加了到馆时限，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 57-36。

en.title: Library lending case 57-36: misshelved call numbers on the self-service kiosk
en.summary: Case 57-36 in Library lending. The reported problem was misshelved call numbers, traced to how the self-service kiosk interacts with the call number. We added a pickup deadline to the reservation queue and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 57-36).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 57-36.

title: 水产养殖案例 57-37：循环水滤床的溶氧夜间跌落
summary: 水产养殖第 57-37 号案例。现场反馈的是溶氧夜间跌落，排查后定位到循环水滤床与分池网箱的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。
outcome: 夜间最低溶氧从 2.1 毫克每升升到 4.3 毫克每升（案例 57-37）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 57-37。

en.title: Aquaculture case 57-37: night dissolved-oxygen drop on the recirculating filter bed
en.summary: Case 57-37 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was night dissolved-oxygen drop, traced to how the recirculating filter bed interacts with the partition net cage. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 57-37).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 57-37.

title: 城市停车案例 57-38：包月名单的包月名单过期
summary: 城市停车第 57-38 号案例。现场反馈的是包月名单过期，排查后定位到包月名单与错峰共享车位的配合方式。处理办法是让包月名单按天同步，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 57-38）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 57-38。

en.title: Urban parking case 57-38: expired pass list on the monthly pass list
en.summary: Case 57-38 in Urban parking. The reported problem was expired pass list, traced to how the monthly pass list interacts with the off-peak shared bay. We synced the pass list daily and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 57-38).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 57-38.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 57-39：出餐口的叫号漏叫
summary: 餐饮出餐第 57-39 号案例。现场反馈的是叫号漏叫，排查后定位到出餐口与备餐台的配合方式。处理办法是把出餐改成按下单时间强排序，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 57-39。

en.title: Restaurant service case 57-39: missed calls on the service window
en.summary: Case 57-39 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was missed calls, traced to how the service window interacts with the prep counter. We forced service order by order time and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: missed-call rate fell from 5.1% to 0.4% (case 57-39).
en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 57-39.

title: 农田灌溉案例 57-40：轮灌轮次表的探头读数漂移
summary: 农田灌溉第 57-40 号案例。现场反馈的是探头读数漂移，排查后定位到轮灌轮次表与田间气象站的配合方式。处理办法是给探头加了两点标定，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 57-40）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 57-40。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 57-40: probe reading drift on the rotation table
en.summary: Case 57-40 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was probe reading drift, traced to how the rotation table interacts with the field weather station. We added two-point calibration to the probe and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 57-40).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 57-40.

title: 医院排班案例 57-41：换班申请单的节假日缺口
summary: 医院排班第 57-41 号案例。现场反馈的是节假日缺口，排查后定位到换班申请单与科室人力池的配合方式。处理办法是把人力池按科室分层，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 57-41）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 57-41。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 57-41: holiday shortfall on the swap request form
en.summary: Case 57-41 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was holiday shortfall, traced to how the swap request form interacts with the department staffing pool. We tiered the staffing pool by department and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 57-41).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 57-41.

title: 地铁调度案例 57-42：列车间隔表的加开车占用冲突
summary: 地铁调度第 57-42 号案例。现场反馈的是加开车占用冲突，排查后定位到列车间隔表与客流闸机的配合方式。处理办法是按站间实际运行时分重算间隔表，并在同一地点复测确认。补了一条什么时候该人工介入的判断标准。
outcome: 折返作业时间从 142 秒压到 118 秒（案例 57-42）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 57-42。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 57-42: extra-train occupancy conflict on the headway table
en.summary: Case 57-42 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was extra-train occupancy conflict, traced to how the headway table interacts with the passenger gate. We recomputed the headway table from measured section times and re-measured at the same site. We added a rule for when a human should step in.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 57-42).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 57-42.

title: 冷链物流案例 57-43：冷藏箱体的预冷不足
summary: 冷链物流第 57-43 号案例。现场反馈的是预冷不足，排查后定位到冷藏箱体与温度记录仪的配合方式。处理办法是给月台加了风幕并改了作业顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 月台温升从 6.5 摄氏度降到 2.1 摄氏度（案例 57-43）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 57-43。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 57-43: insufficient pre-cooling on the refrigerated container
en.summary: Case 57-43 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was insufficient pre-cooling, traced to how the refrigerated container interacts with the temperature logger. We added an air curtain and reordered dock operations and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 57-43).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 57-43.

title: 快递分拣案例 57-44：返流皮带的异形件误入主线
summary: 快递分拣第 57-44 号案例。现场反馈的是异形件误入主线，排查后定位到返流皮带与交叉带分拣机的配合方式。处理办法是把返流皮带速度与主线解耦，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 57-44。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 57-44: irregular items entering the main line on the recirculation belt
en.summary: Case 57-44 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was irregular items entering the main line, traced to how the recirculation belt interacts with the cross-belt sorter. We decoupled recirculation belt speed from the main line and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 57-44).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 57-44.
concepts: irregular items entering the main line

title: 光伏运维案例 57-45：汇流箱的日报口径不一致
summary: 光伏运维第 57-45 号案例。现场反馈的是日报口径不一致，排查后定位到汇流箱与清洗机器人的配合方式。处理办法是按组串电流分布重新分组，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 57-45）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 57-45。

en.title: PV plant operations case 57-45: inconsistent report definitions on the combiner box
en.summary: Case 57-45 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was inconsistent report definitions, traced to how the combiner box interacts with the cleaning robot. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 57-45).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 57-45.

title: 图书借阅案例 57-46：逾期通知的密集书库取书慢
summary: 图书借阅第 57-46 号案例。现场反馈的是密集书库取书慢，排查后定位到逾期通知与密集书库的配合方式。处理办法是把逾期通知改成三段提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。补了一段为什么之前的判据不适用。
outcome: 逾期通知送达率从 82% 升到 99%（案例 57-46）。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 57-46。

en.title: Library lending case 57-46: slow retrieval from compact stacks on the overdue notice
en.summary: Case 57-46 in Library lending. The reported problem was slow retrieval from compact stacks, traced to how the overdue notice interacts with the compact stacks. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. We added a note on why the earlier criterion did not apply.
en.outcome: overdue notice delivery rose from 82% to 99% (case 57-46).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 57-46.

title: 水产养殖案例 57-47：循环水滤床的溶氧夜间跌落
summary: 水产养殖第 57-47 号案例。现场反馈的是溶氧夜间跌落，排查后定位到循环水滤床与分池网箱的配合方式。处理办法是按体重重算投饵率，并在同一地点复测确认。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 57-47）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 57-47。

en.title: Aquaculture case 57-47: night dissolved-oxygen drop on the recirculating filter bed
en.summary: Case 57-47 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was night dissolved-oxygen drop, traced to how the recirculating filter bed interacts with the partition net cage. We recomputed feeding rate by body weight and re-measured at the same site. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 57-47).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 57-47.

title: 城市停车案例 57-48：道闸的出场排队
summary: 城市停车第 57-48 号案例。现场反馈的是出场排队，排查后定位到道闸与车位诱导屏的配合方式。处理办法是把识别结果加了二次比对，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 57-48）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 57-48。

en.title: Urban parking case 57-48: exit queueing on the barrier gate
en.summary: Case 57-48 in Urban parking. The reported problem was exit queueing, traced to how the barrier gate interacts with the guidance screen. We added a second comparison to plate results and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 57-48).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 57-48.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 57-49：叫号屏的出餐乱序
summary: 餐饮出餐第 57-49 号案例。现场反馈的是出餐乱序，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是把外卖产能单独留了两个灶口，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 出餐乱序投诉当月从 31 条降到 4 条（案例 57-49）。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 57-49。

en.title: Restaurant service case 57-49: out-of-order service on the number screen
en.summary: Case 57-49 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We reserved two burners for takeaway capacity and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-order complaints fell from 31 to 4 that month (case 57-49).
en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 57-49.

title: 农田灌溉案例 57-50：首部过滤器的过滤器堵塞频繁
summary: 农田灌溉第 57-50 号案例。现场反馈的是过滤器堵塞频繁，排查后定位到首部过滤器与轮灌轮次表的配合方式。处理办法是把雨量判据从日累计改成小时累计，并在同一地点复测确认。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。
outcome: 反冲洗次数每天从 9 次降到 3 次（案例 57-50）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 57-50。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 57-50: frequent filter clogging on the head filter
en.summary: Case 57-50 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was frequent filter clogging, traced to how the head filter interacts with the rotation table. We changed the rain criterion from daily to hourly and re-measured at the same site. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 57-50).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 57-50.

title: 医院排班案例 57-51：夜班组的人力池调用越界
summary: 医院排班第 57-51 号案例。现场反馈的是人力池调用越界，排查后定位到夜班组与值班表模板的配合方式。处理办法是把节假日缺口提前四周预警，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 57-51）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 57-51。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 57-51: out-of-scope pool borrowing on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 57-51 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was out-of-scope pool borrowing, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We raised holiday shortfall alerts four weeks ahead and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 57-51).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 57-51.

title: 地铁调度案例 57-52：折返线的折返效率下降
summary: 地铁调度第 57-52 号案例。现场反馈的是折返效率下降，排查后定位到折返线与列车间隔表的配合方式。处理办法是把折返作业拆成两段并行，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。预测用的模型换过一次参数，口径随之更新。
outcome: 早高峰间隔波动从 ±35 秒收到 ±12 秒（案例 57-52）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 57-52。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 57-52: turnback efficiency drop on the turnback track
en.summary: Case 57-52 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was turnback efficiency drop, traced to how the turnback track interacts with the headway table. We split the turnback into two parallel phases and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way. The forecasting model had its parameters changed once, and the metric definition followed.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 57-52).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 57-52.

title: 冷链物流案例 57-53：预冷间的月台温升
summary: 冷链物流第 57-53 号案例。现场反馈的是月台温升，排查后定位到预冷间与干冰配额表的配合方式。处理办法是把预冷时长按品类分档，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 57-53）。
learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 57-53。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 57-53: dock temperature rise on the pre-cooling room
en.summary: Case 57-53 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the pre-cooling room interacts with the dry ice quota table. We tiered pre-cooling time by product category and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 57-53).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 57-53.

title: 快递分拣案例 57-54：异形件通道的异形件误入主线
summary: 快递分拣第 57-54 号案例。现场反馈的是异形件误入主线，排查后定位到异形件通道与返流皮带的配合方式。处理办法是在入口加了异形件预分流，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 57-54。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 57-54: irregular items entering the main line on the irregular-item lane
en.summary: Case 57-54 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was irregular items entering the main line, traced to how the irregular-item lane interacts with the recirculation belt. We added irregular-item pre-diversion at the inlet and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way. We had to judge whether the weather made it a one-off.
en.outcome: label recognition recovered from 93.5% to 99.1% (case 57-54).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 57-54.
concepts: irregular items entering the main line

title: 光伏运维案例 57-55：汇流箱的汇流箱温升
summary: 光伏运维第 57-55 号案例。现场反馈的是汇流箱温升，排查后定位到汇流箱与清洗机器人的配合方式。处理办法是让清洗周期跟着积灰速率走，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 同口径发电量差异从 6% 收到 1%（案例 57-55）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 57-55。

en.title: PV plant operations case 57-55: combiner box temperature rise on the combiner box
en.summary: Case 57-55 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the combiner box interacts with the cleaning robot. We tied the cleaning cycle to dust accumulation rate and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: same-definition generation gap narrowed from 6% to 1% (case 57-55).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 57-55.

title: 图书借阅案例 57-56：书目索书号的逾期通知漏发
summary: 图书借阅第 57-56 号案例。现场反馈的是逾期通知漏发，排查后定位到书目索书号与预约队列的配合方式。处理办法是把密集书库取书按区块批量化，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 逾期通知送达率从 82% 升到 99%（案例 57-56）。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 57-56。

en.title: Library lending case 57-56: missed overdue notices on the call number
en.summary: Case 57-56 in Library lending. The reported problem was missed overdue notices, traced to how the call number interacts with the reservation queue. We batched compact-stack retrieval by block and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: overdue notice delivery rose from 82% to 99% (case 57-56).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 57-56.

title: 水产养殖案例 57-57：增氧机的滤床短路流
summary: 水产养殖第 57-57 号案例。现场反馈的是滤床短路流，排查后定位到增氧机与投饵机的配合方式。处理办法是按体重重算投饵率，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 夜间最低溶氧从 2.1 毫克每升升到 4.3 毫克每升（案例 57-57）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 57-57。

en.title: Aquaculture case 57-57: filter bed short-circuiting on the aerator
en.summary: Case 57-57 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the aerator interacts with the feeder. We recomputed feeding rate by body weight and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 57-57).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 57-57.

title: 城市停车案例 57-58：包月名单的包月名单过期
summary: 城市停车第 57-58 号案例。现场反馈的是包月名单过期，排查后定位到包月名单与错峰共享车位的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 共享车位周转率提高一倍（案例 57-58）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 57-58。

en.title: Urban parking case 57-58: expired pass list on the monthly pass list
en.summary: Case 57-58 in Urban parking. The reported problem was expired pass list, traced to how the monthly pass list interacts with the off-peak shared bay. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: shared bay turnover doubled (case 57-58).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 57-58.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 57-59：备餐台的外卖与堂食抢产能
summary: 餐饮出餐第 57-59 号案例。现场反馈的是外卖与堂食抢产能，排查后定位到备餐台与叫号屏的配合方式。处理办法是把出餐改成按下单时间强排序，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 出餐乱序投诉当月从 31 条降到 4 条（案例 57-59）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 57-59。

en.title: Restaurant service case 57-59: takeaway competing with dine-in on the prep counter
en.summary: Case 57-59 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was takeaway competing with dine-in, traced to how the prep counter interacts with the number screen. We forced service order by order time and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-order complaints fell from 31 to 4 that month (case 57-59).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 57-59.

title: 农田灌溉案例 57-60：首部过滤器的轮次冲突
summary: 农田灌溉第 57-60 号案例。现场反馈的是轮次冲突，排查后定位到首部过滤器与轮灌轮次表的配合方式。处理办法是把雨量判据从日累计改成小时累计，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 57-60）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 57-60。

en.summary: Case 57-60 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was rotation conflicts, traced to how the head filter interacts with the rotation table. We changed the rain criterion from daily to hourly and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 57-60).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 57-60.

title: 医院排班案例 57-61：值班表模板的连班超时
summary: 医院排班第 57-61 号案例。现场反馈的是连班超时，排查后定位到值班表模板与换班申请单的配合方式。处理办法是给换班链加了闭环检查，并在同一地点复测确认。现场问过一句：能不能先按老办法顶两天。补了一段为什么之前的判据不适用。排产用的模型只按历史均值走，遇到突发就偏。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 57-61: back-to-back shift overrun on the roster template
en.summary: Case 57-61 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was back-to-back shift overrun, traced to how the roster template interacts with the swap request form. We added a closed-loop check to swap chains and re-measured at the same site. Someone on site asked whether the old procedure could hold for two more days. We added a note on why the earlier criterion did not apply. The scheduling model follows historical averages only and drifts under sudden load.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 57-61).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 57-61.

title: 地铁调度案例 57-62：站台屏蔽门的闸机限流不及时

en.title: Metro dispatching case 57-62: late gate throttling on the platform screen door

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 57-63: dock temperature rise on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 57-63 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. en.summary: Case 57-67 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was night dissolved-oxygen drop, traced to how the aerator interacts with the feeder. We recomputed feeding rate by body weight and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.

en.title: Urban parking case 57-68: exit queueing on the off-peak shared bay
en.summary: Case 57-68 in Urban parking. The reported problem was exit queueing, traced to how the off-peak shared bay interacts with the barrier gate. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 57-68).

en.summary: Case 57-69 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the takeaway packing area interacts with the peak prep sheet. en.title: Farm irrigation case 57-70: probe reading drift on the soil moisture probe
en.summary: Case 57-70 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was probe reading drift, traced to how the soil moisture probe interacts with the head filter. en.outcome: rotation conflicts fell to zero for the season (case 57-70).

en.title: Metro dispatching case 57-72: turnback efficiency drop on the peak extra train
en.summary: Case 57-72 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was turnback efficiency drop, traced to how the peak extra train interacts with the platform screen door. We split the turnback into two parallel phases and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
