en.title: Urban parking case 61-88: exit queueing on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 61-88 in Urban parking. The reported problem was exit queueing, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We added a second comparison to plate results and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: shared bay turnover doubled (case 61-88).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 61-88.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 61-89：叫号屏的叫号漏叫
summary: 餐饮出餐第 61-89 号案例。现场反馈的是叫号漏叫，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是把备餐台按冷热分区，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 61-89。

en.title: Restaurant service case 61-89: missed calls on the number screen
en.summary: Case 61-89 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was missed calls, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.

en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 61-89.

summary: 农田灌溉第 61-90 号案例。现场反馈的是过滤器堵塞频繁，排查后定位到土壤湿度探头与首部过滤器的配合方式。处理办法是给探头加了两点标定，并在同一地点复测确认。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 61-90: frequent filter clogging on the soil moisture probe
en.summary: Case 61-90 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was frequent filter clogging, traced to how the soil moisture probe interacts with the head filter. We added two-point calibration to the probe and re-measured at the same site. We had to judge whether the weather made it a one-off.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 61-90).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 61-90.

title: 医院排班案例 61-91：夜班组的换班链断裂

en.title: Hospital rostering case 61-91: broken swap chain on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 61-91 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We added a closed-loop check to swap chains and re-measured at the same site. We wrote down why last year's plan was not reused.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 61-91).

title: 地铁调度案例 61-92：站台屏蔽门的折返效率下降

en.title: Metro dispatching case 61-92: turnback efficiency drop on the platform screen door
en.summary: Case 61-92 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was turnback efficiency drop, traced to how the platform screen door interacts with the turnback track. We tied gate throttling to platform density and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 61-92).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 61-92.

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 61-93: dock temperature rise on the refrigerated container
en.summary: Case 61-93 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the refrigerated container interacts with the temperature logger. We added an air curtain and reordered dock operations and re-measured at the same site. The scheduling model follows historical averages only and drifts under sudden load.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 61-93).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 61-93.

en.title: Parcel sorting case 61-94: cross-belt slippage on the cross-belt sorter
en.summary: Case 61-94 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was cross-belt slippage, traced to how the cross-belt sorter interacts with the chute allocation table. en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 61-94).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 61-94.

en.title: PV plant operations case 61-95: combiner box temperature rise on the cleaning robot
en.summary: Case 61-95 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the cleaning robot interacts with the tilt mount. We adjusted tilt twice by season and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 61-95).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 61-95.

title: 图书借阅案例 61-96：书目索书号的借还机识别失败

en.title: Library lending case 61-96: kiosk read failures on the call number
en.summary: Case 61-96 in Library lending. The reported problem was kiosk read failures, traced to how the call number interacts with the reservation queue. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site.

en.title: Aquaculture case 61-97: overfeeding on the partition net cage
en.summary: Case 61-97 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was overfeeding, traced to how the partition net cage interacts with the aerator. en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 61-97).

summary: 城市停车第 61-98 号案例。现场反馈的是包月名单过期，排查后定位到道闸与车位诱导屏的配合方式。处理办法是把识别结果加了二次比对，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。

en.title: Urban parking case 61-98: expired pass list on the barrier gate
en.summary: Case 61-98 in Urban parking. The reported problem was expired pass list, traced to how the barrier gate interacts with the guidance screen. We added a second comparison to plate results and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 61-98).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 61-98.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 61-99：外卖打包区的出餐乱序
summary: 餐饮出餐第 61-99 号案例。现场反馈的是出餐乱序，排查后定位到外卖打包区与高峰配菜表的配合方式。处理办法是把备餐台按冷热分区，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 61-99）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 61-99。

en.title: Restaurant service case 61-99: out-of-order service on the takeaway packing area
en.summary: Case 61-99 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the takeaway packing area interacts with the peak prep sheet. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 61-99).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 61-99.

title: 农田灌溉案例 62-00：土壤湿度探头的过滤器堵塞频繁
summary: 农田灌溉第 62-00 号案例。现场反馈的是过滤器堵塞频繁，排查后定位到土壤湿度探头与首部过滤器的配合方式。处理办法是把雨量判据从日累计改成小时累计，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 轮次冲突当季清零（案例 62-00）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 62-00。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 62-00: frequent filter clogging on the soil moisture probe
en.summary: Case 62-00 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was frequent filter clogging, traced to how the soil moisture probe interacts with the head filter. We changed the rain criterion from daily to hourly and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: rotation conflicts fell to zero for the season (case 62-00).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 62-00.

title: 医院排班案例 62-01：换班申请单的换班链断裂
summary: 医院排班第 62-01 号案例。现场反馈的是换班链断裂，排查后定位到换班申请单与科室人力池的配合方式。处理办法是让台账以打卡为准，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 62-01）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 62-01。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 62-01: broken swap chain on the swap request form
en.summary: Case 62-01 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the swap request form interacts with the department staffing pool. We made clock-in authoritative for the ledger and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 62-01).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 62-01.

title: 地铁调度案例 62-02：站台屏蔽门的间隔波动
summary: 地铁调度第 62-02 号案例。现场反馈的是间隔波动，排查后定位到站台屏蔽门与折返线的配合方式。处理办法是给加开车固定了占用窗口，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 早高峰间隔波动从 ±35 秒收到 ±12 秒（案例 62-02）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 62-02。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 62-02: headway jitter on the platform screen door
en.summary: Case 62-02 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was headway jitter, traced to how the platform screen door interacts with the turnback track. We fixed an occupancy window for extra trains and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 62-02).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 62-02.

title: 冷链物流案例 62-03：装卸月台的月台温升
summary: 冷链物流第 62-03 号案例。现场反馈的是月台温升，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是把记录仪采样从 5 分钟改成 1 分钟，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 到货温度超标批次当季从 11 批降到 1 批（案例 62-03）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 62-03。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 62-03: dock temperature rise on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 62-03 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We changed logger sampling from 5 minutes to 1 minute and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-spec arrival batches fell from 11 to 1 for the season (case 62-03).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 62-03.

title: 快递分拣案例 62-04：交叉带分拣机的面单识别率下降
summary: 快递分拣第 62-04 号案例。现场反馈的是面单识别率下降，排查后定位到交叉带分拣机与格口分配表的配合方式。处理办法是把返流皮带速度与主线解耦，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 62-04。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 62-04: label recognition drop on the cross-belt sorter
en.summary: Case 62-04 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was label recognition drop, traced to how the cross-belt sorter interacts with the chute allocation table. We decoupled recirculation belt speed from the main line and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 62-04).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 62-04.

title: 光伏运维案例 62-05：组串逆变器的清洗周期不合理
summary: 光伏运维第 62-05 号案例。现场反馈的是清洗周期不合理，排查后定位到组串逆变器与汇流箱的配合方式。处理办法是让清洗周期跟着积灰速率走，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 62-05）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 62-05。

en.title: PV plant operations case 62-05: unsuitable cleaning cycle on the string inverter
en.summary: Case 62-05 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was unsuitable cleaning cycle, traced to how the string inverter interacts with the combiner box. We tied the cleaning cycle to dust accumulation rate and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 62-05).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 62-05.

title: 图书借阅案例 62-06：书目索书号的密集书库取书慢
summary: 图书借阅第 62-06 号案例。现场反馈的是密集书库取书慢，排查后定位到书目索书号与预约队列的配合方式。处理办法是按楼层重排索书号巡架顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 预约平均等待从 11 天降到 4 天（案例 62-06）。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 62-06。

en.title: Library lending case 62-06: slow retrieval from compact stacks on the call number
en.summary: Case 62-06 in Library lending. The reported problem was slow retrieval from compact stacks, traced to how the call number interacts with the reservation queue. We reordered shelf-reading by floor and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 62-06).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 62-06.

title: 水产养殖案例 62-07：水质探头的滤床短路流
summary: 水产养殖第 62-07 号案例。现场反馈的是滤床短路流，排查后定位到水质探头与循环水滤床的配合方式。处理办法是把增氧机改成按溶氧闭环启停，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 62-07）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 62-07。

en.title: Aquaculture case 62-07: filter bed short-circuiting on the water quality probe
en.summary: Case 62-07 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the water quality probe interacts with the recirculating filter bed. We switched aerators to closed-loop dissolved-oxygen control and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 62-07).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 62-07.

title: 城市停车案例 62-08：包月名单的出场排队
summary: 城市停车第 62-08 号案例。现场反馈的是出场排队，排查后定位到包月名单与错峰共享车位的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 62-08）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 62-08。

en.title: Urban parking case 62-08: exit queueing on the monthly pass list
en.summary: Case 62-08 in Urban parking. The reported problem was exit queueing, traced to how the monthly pass list interacts with the off-peak shared bay. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 62-08).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 62-08.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 62-09：高峰配菜表的外卖与堂食抢产能
summary: 餐饮出餐第 62-09 号案例。现场反馈的是外卖与堂食抢产能，排查后定位到高峰配菜表与出餐口的配合方式。处理办法是给叫号屏加了重复提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 出餐乱序投诉当月从 31 条降到 4 条（案例 62-09）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 62-09。

en.title: Restaurant service case 62-09: takeaway competing with dine-in on the peak prep sheet
en.summary: Case 62-09 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was takeaway competing with dine-in, traced to how the peak prep sheet interacts with the service window. We added repeat prompts to the number screen and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: out-of-order complaints fell from 31 to 4 that month (case 62-09).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 62-09.

title: 农田灌溉案例 62-10：干管阀组的轮次冲突
summary: 农田灌溉第 62-10 号案例。现场反馈的是轮次冲突，排查后定位到干管阀组与土壤湿度探头的配合方式。处理办法是把轮次表按地块高差重排了一遍，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 62-10）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 62-10。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 62-10: rotation conflicts on the main valve group
en.summary: Case 62-10 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was rotation conflicts, traced to how the main valve group interacts with the soil moisture probe. We reordered the rotation table by plot elevation and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 62-10).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 62-10.

title: 医院排班案例 62-11：夜班组的人力池调用越界
summary: 医院排班第 62-11 号案例。现场反馈的是人力池调用越界，排查后定位到夜班组与值班表模板的配合方式。处理办法是把连班上限写进模板校验，并在同一地点复测确认。补了一段为什么之前的判据不适用。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 62-11）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 62-11。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 62-11: out-of-scope pool borrowing on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 62-11 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was out-of-scope pool borrowing, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We moved the back-to-back cap into template validation and re-measured at the same site. We added a note on why the earlier criterion did not apply.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 62-11).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 62-11.

title: 地铁调度案例 62-12：站台屏蔽门的间隔波动
summary: 地铁调度第 62-12 号案例。现场反馈的是间隔波动，排查后定位到站台屏蔽门与折返线的配合方式。处理办法是让闸机限流跟着站台密度走，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 开门时间超标当周清零（案例 62-12）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 62-12。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 62-12: headway jitter on the platform screen door
en.summary: Case 62-12 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was headway jitter, traced to how the platform screen door interacts with the turnback track. We tied gate throttling to platform density and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: door dwell overruns fell to zero that week (case 62-12).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 62-12.

title: 冷链物流案例 62-13：预冷间的干冰配额不够
summary: 冷链物流第 62-13 号案例。现场反馈的是干冰配额不够，排查后定位到预冷间与干冰配额表的配合方式。处理办法是给月台加了风幕并改了作业顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 到货温度超标批次当季从 11 批降到 1 批（案例 62-13）。
learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 62-13。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 62-13: dry ice quota shortfall on the pre-cooling room
en.summary: Case 62-13 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dry ice quota shortfall, traced to how the pre-cooling room interacts with the dry ice quota table. We added an air curtain and reordered dock operations and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-spec arrival batches fell from 11 to 1 for the season (case 62-13).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 62-13.

title: 快递分拣案例 62-14：交叉带分拣机的异形件误入主线
summary: 快递分拣第 62-14 号案例。现场反馈的是异形件误入主线，排查后定位到交叉带分拣机与格口分配表的配合方式。处理办法是在入口加了异形件预分流，并在同一地点复测确认。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 62-14。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 62-14: irregular items entering the main line on the cross-belt sorter
en.summary: Case 62-14 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was irregular items entering the main line, traced to how the cross-belt sorter interacts with the chute allocation table. We added irregular-item pre-diversion at the inlet and re-measured at the same site. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 62-14).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 62-14.
concepts: irregular items entering the main line

title: 光伏运维案例 62-15：倾角支架的倾角季节性偏差
summary: 光伏运维第 62-15 号案例。现场反馈的是倾角季节性偏差，排查后定位到倾角支架与发电量日报的配合方式。处理办法是按季节调了两次倾角，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 62-15）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 62-15。

en.title: PV plant operations case 62-15: seasonal tilt deviation on the tilt mount
en.summary: Case 62-15 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was seasonal tilt deviation, traced to how the tilt mount interacts with the daily generation report. We adjusted tilt twice by season and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 62-15).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 62-15.

title: 图书借阅案例 62-16：预约队列的逾期通知漏发
summary: 图书借阅第 62-16 号案例。现场反馈的是逾期通知漏发，排查后定位到预约队列与逾期通知的配合方式。处理办法是把逾期通知改成三段提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。预测用的模型换过一次参数，口径随之更新。
outcome: 预约平均等待从 11 天降到 4 天（案例 62-16）。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 62-16。

en.title: Library lending case 62-16: missed overdue notices on the reservation queue
en.summary: Case 62-16 in Library lending. The reported problem was missed overdue notices, traced to how the reservation queue interacts with the overdue notice. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives. The forecasting model had its parameters changed once, and the metric definition followed.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 62-16).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 62-16.

title: 水产养殖案例 62-17：投饵机的投饵过量
summary: 水产养殖第 62-17 号案例。现场反馈的是投饵过量，排查后定位到投饵机与水质探头的配合方式。处理办法是把增氧机改成按溶氧闭环启停，并在同一地点复测确认。争论点是能不能只改一处就够。预测用的模型换过一次参数，口径随之更新。
outcome: 夜间最低溶氧从 2.1 毫克每升升到 4.3 毫克每升（案例 62-17）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 62-17。

en.title: Aquaculture case 62-17: overfeeding on the feeder
en.summary: Case 62-17 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was overfeeding, traced to how the feeder interacts with the water quality probe. We switched aerators to closed-loop dissolved-oxygen control and re-measured at the same site. The argument was whether changing one place would be enough. The forecasting model had its parameters changed once, and the metric definition followed.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 62-17).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 62-17.

title: 城市停车案例 62-18：车位诱导屏的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 62-18 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到车位诱导屏与高位视频桩的配合方式。处理办法是把诱导屏刷新从 5 分钟改成 30 秒，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 62-18）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 62-18。

en.title: Urban parking case 62-18: stale guidance data on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 62-18 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 62-18).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 62-18.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 62-19：外卖打包区的外卖与堂食抢产能

title: 地铁调度案例 62-82：折返线的闸机限流不及时
summary: 地铁调度第 62-82 号案例。现场反馈的是闸机限流不及时，排查后定位到折返线与列车间隔表的配合方式。处理办法是给加开车固定了占用窗口，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 折返作业时间从 142 秒压到 118 秒（案例 62-82）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 62-82。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 62-82: late gate throttling on the turnback track
en.summary: Case 62-82 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was late gate throttling, traced to how the turnback track interacts with the headway table. We fixed an occupancy window for extra trains and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 62-82).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 62-82.

title: 冷链物流案例 62-83：预冷间的箱门密封失效
summary: 冷链物流第 62-83 号案例。现场反馈的是箱门密封失效，排查后定位到预冷间与干冰配额表的配合方式。处理办法是按里程与季节重算干冰配额，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 月台温升从 6.5 摄氏度降到 2.1 摄氏度（案例 62-83）。
learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 62-83。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 62-83: door seal failure on the pre-cooling room
en.summary: Case 62-83 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was door seal failure, traced to how the pre-cooling room interacts with the dry ice quota table. We recomputed dry ice quota by distance and season and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 62-83).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 62-83.

title: 快递分拣案例 62-84：异形件通道的格口爆仓
summary: 快递分拣第 62-84 号案例。现场反馈的是格口爆仓，排查后定位到异形件通道与返流皮带的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。排产用的模型只按历史均值走，遇到突发就偏。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 62-84。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 62-84: chute overflow on the irregular-item lane
en.summary: Case 62-84 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was chute overflow, traced to how the irregular-item lane interacts with the recirculation belt. We reordered chute allocation by destination flow and re-measured at the same site. The scheduling model follows historical averages only and drifts under sudden load. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: label recognition recovered from 93.5% to 99.1% (case 62-84).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 62-84.

title: 光伏运维案例 62-85：倾角支架的汇流箱温升
summary: 光伏运维第 62-85 号案例。现场反馈的是汇流箱温升，排查后定位到倾角支架与发电量日报的配合方式。处理办法是按组串电流分布重新分组，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 同口径发电量差异从 6% 收到 1%（案例 62-85）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 62-85。

en.title: PV plant operations case 62-85: combiner box temperature rise on the tilt mount
en.summary: Case 62-85 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the tilt mount interacts with the daily generation report. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: same-definition generation gap narrowed from 6% to 1% (case 62-85).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 62-85.

title: 图书借阅案例 62-86：逾期通知的密集书库取书慢
summary: 图书借阅第 62-86 号案例。现场反馈的是密集书库取书慢，排查后定位到逾期通知与密集书库的配合方式。处理办法是按楼层重排索书号巡架顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 62-86。

en.title: Library lending case 62-86: slow retrieval from compact stacks on the overdue notice
en.summary: Case 62-86 in Library lending. The reported problem was slow retrieval from compact stacks, traced to how the overdue notice interacts with the compact stacks. We reordered shelf-reading by floor and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 62-86).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 62-86.

title: 水产养殖案例 62-87：循环水滤床的投饵过量
summary: 水产养殖第 62-87 号案例。现场反馈的是投饵过量，排查后定位到循环水滤床与分池网箱的配合方式。处理办法是把增氧机改成按溶氧闭环启停，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 夜间最低溶氧从 2.1 毫克每升升到 4.3 毫克每升（案例 62-87）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 62-87。

en.title: Aquaculture case 62-87: overfeeding on the recirculating filter bed
en.summary: Case 62-87 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was overfeeding, traced to how the recirculating filter bed interacts with the partition net cage. We switched aerators to closed-loop dissolved-oxygen control and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 62-87).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 62-87.

title: 城市停车案例 62-88：车位诱导屏的车牌识别错配
summary: 城市停车第 62-88 号案例。现场反馈的是车牌识别错配，排查后定位到车位诱导屏与高位视频桩的配合方式。处理办法是让包月名单按天同步，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 62-88）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 62-88。

en.title: Urban parking case 62-88: plate mismatch on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 62-88 in Urban parking. The reported problem was plate mismatch, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We synced the pass list daily and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 62-88).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 62-88.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 62-89：叫号屏的外卖与堂食抢产能
summary: 餐饮出餐第 62-89 号案例。现场反馈的是外卖与堂食抢产能，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是给叫号屏加了重复提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。定了什么时候必须停线检查。
outcome: 出餐乱序投诉当月从 31 条降到 4 条（案例 62-89）。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 62-89。

en.title: Restaurant service case 62-89: takeaway competing with dine-in on the number screen
en.summary: Case 62-89 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was takeaway competing with dine-in, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We added repeat prompts to the number screen and re-measured at the same site. We set when the line must stop for inspection.
en.outcome: out-of-order complaints fell from 31 to 4 that month (case 62-89).
en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 62-89.

title: 农田灌溉案例 62-90：首部过滤器的轮次冲突
summary: 农田灌溉第 62-90 号案例。现场反馈的是轮次冲突，排查后定位到首部过滤器与轮灌轮次表的配合方式。处理办法是把雨量判据从日累计改成小时累计，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 反冲洗次数每天从 9 次降到 3 次（案例 62-90）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 62-90。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 62-90: rotation conflicts on the head filter
en.summary: Case 62-90 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was rotation conflicts, traced to how the head filter interacts with the rotation table. We changed the rain criterion from daily to hourly and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 62-90).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 62-90.

title: 医院排班案例 62-91：换班申请单的连班超时
summary: 医院排班第 62-91 号案例。现场反馈的是连班超时，排查后定位到换班申请单与科室人力池的配合方式。处理办法是把人力池按科室分层，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 62-91）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 62-91。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 62-91: back-to-back shift overrun on the swap request form
en.summary: Case 62-91 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was back-to-back shift overrun, traced to how the swap request form interacts with the department staffing pool. We tiered the staffing pool by department and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 62-91).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 62-91.

title: 地铁调度案例 62-92：早高峰加开车的折返效率下降
summary: 地铁调度第 62-92 号案例。现场反馈的是折返效率下降，排查后定位到早高峰加开车与站台屏蔽门的配合方式。处理办法是让闸机限流跟着站台密度走，并在同一地点复测确认。补了一段为什么之前的判据不适用。
outcome: 折返作业时间从 142 秒压到 118 秒（案例 62-92）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 62-92。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 62-92: turnback efficiency drop on the peak extra train
en.summary: Case 62-92 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was turnback efficiency drop, traced to how the peak extra train interacts with the platform screen door. We tied gate throttling to platform density and re-measured at the same site. We added a note on why the earlier criterion did not apply.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 62-92).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 62-92.

title: 冷链物流案例 62-93：装卸月台的箱门密封失效
summary: 冷链物流第 62-93 号案例。现场反馈的是箱门密封失效，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是把预冷时长按品类分档，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 到货温度超标批次当季从 11 批降到 1 批（案例 62-93）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 62-93。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 62-93: door seal failure on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 62-93 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was door seal failure, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We tiered pre-cooling time by product category and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-spec arrival batches fell from 11 to 1 for the season (case 62-93).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 62-93.

title: 快递分拣案例 62-94：异形件通道的返流比例升高
summary: 快递分拣第 62-94 号案例。现场反馈的是返流比例升高，排查后定位到异形件通道与返流皮带的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。定了什么时候必须停线检查。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 62-94。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 62-94: rising recirculation ratio on the irregular-item lane
en.summary: Case 62-94 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was rising recirculation ratio, traced to how the irregular-item lane interacts with the recirculation belt. We reordered chute allocation by destination flow and re-measured at the same site. We set when the line must stop for inspection.
en.outcome: label recognition recovered from 93.5% to 99.1% (case 62-94).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 62-94.

title: 光伏运维案例 62-95：发电量日报的倾角季节性偏差
summary: 光伏运维第 62-95 号案例。现场反馈的是倾角季节性偏差，排查后定位到发电量日报与组串逆变器的配合方式。处理办法是让清洗周期跟着积灰速率走，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 62-95）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 62-95。

en.title: PV plant operations case 62-95: seasonal tilt deviation on the daily generation report
en.summary: Case 62-95 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was seasonal tilt deviation, traced to how the daily generation report interacts with the string inverter. We tied the cleaning cycle to dust accumulation rate and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 62-95).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 62-95.

title: 图书借阅案例 62-96：书目索书号的逾期通知漏发
summary: 图书借阅第 62-96 号案例。现场反馈的是逾期通知漏发，排查后定位到书目索书号与预约队列的配合方式。处理办法是把逾期通知改成三段提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。写清为什么这次没有沿用去年的方案。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 62-96。

en.title: Library lending case 62-96: missed overdue notices on the call number
en.summary: Case 62-96 in Library lending. The reported problem was missed overdue notices, traced to how the call number interacts with the reservation queue. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed. We wrote down why last year's plan was not reused.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 62-96).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 62-96.

title: 水产养殖案例 62-97：循环水滤床的滤床短路流
summary: 水产养殖第 62-97 号案例。现场反馈的是滤床短路流，排查后定位到循环水滤床与分池网箱的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 62-97）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 62-97。

en.title: Aquaculture case 62-97: filter bed short-circuiting on the recirculating filter bed
en.summary: Case 62-97 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the recirculating filter bed interacts with the partition net cage. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 62-97).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 62-97.

title: 城市停车案例 62-98：高位视频桩的共享车位被长期占用
summary: 城市停车第 62-98 号案例。现场反馈的是共享车位被长期占用，排查后定位到高位视频桩与包月名单的配合方式。处理办法是把识别结果加了二次比对，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 62-98）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 62-98。

en.title: Urban parking case 62-98: shared bays held long-term on the overhead video pole
en.summary: Case 62-98 in Urban parking. The reported problem was shared bays held long-term, traced to how the overhead video pole interacts with the monthly pass list. We added a second comparison to plate results and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 62-98).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 62-98.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 62-99：出餐口的出餐乱序
summary: 餐饮出餐第 62-99 号案例。现场反馈的是出餐乱序，排查后定位到出餐口与备餐台的配合方式。处理办法是给叫号屏加了重复提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 62-99。

en.title: Restaurant service case 62-99: out-of-order service on the service window
en.summary: Case 62-99 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the service window interacts with the prep counter. We added repeat prompts to the number screen and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: missed-call rate fell from 5.1% to 0.4% (case 62-99).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 62-99.

title: 农田灌溉案例 63-00：首部过滤器的轮次冲突
summary: 农田灌溉第 63-00 号案例。现场反馈的是轮次冲突，排查后定位到首部过滤器与轮灌轮次表的配合方式。处理办法是把轮次表按地块高差重排了一遍，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 63-00）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 63-00。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 63-00: rotation conflicts on the head filter
en.summary: Case 63-00 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was rotation conflicts, traced to how the head filter interacts with the rotation table. We reordered the rotation table by plot elevation and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 63-00).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 63-00.

title: 医院排班案例 63-01：科室人力池的节假日缺口
summary: 医院排班第 63-01 号案例。现场反馈的是节假日缺口，排查后定位到科室人力池与加班台账的配合方式。处理办法是把人力池按科室分层，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 连班超时当月从 14 例降到 0 例（案例 63-01）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 63-01。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 63-01: holiday shortfall on the department staffing pool
en.summary: Case 63-01 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was holiday shortfall, traced to how the department staffing pool interacts with the overtime ledger. We tiered the staffing pool by department and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 63-01).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 63-01.

title: 地铁调度案例 63-02：折返线的折返效率下降
summary: 地铁调度第 63-02 号案例。现场反馈的是折返效率下降，排查后定位到折返线与列车间隔表的配合方式。处理办法是让闸机限流跟着站台密度走，并在同一地点复测确认。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。
outcome: 折返作业时间从 142 秒压到 118 秒（案例 63-02）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 63-02。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 63-02: turnback efficiency drop on the turnback track
en.summary: Case 63-02 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was turnback efficiency drop, traced to how the turnback track interacts with the headway table. We tied gate throttling to platform density and re-measured at the same site. We had to judge whether the weather made it a one-off.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 63-02).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 63-02.

title: 冷链物流案例 63-03：温度记录仪的记录仪掉点
summary: 冷链物流第 63-03 号案例。现场反馈的是记录仪掉点，排查后定位到温度记录仪与装卸月台的配合方式。处理办法是按里程与季节重算干冰配额，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 63-03）。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 63-03: logger data gaps on the temperature logger

en.summary: Case 63-35 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was unsuitable cleaning cycle, traced to how the cleaning robot interacts with the tilt mount. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives. The scheduling model follows historical averages only and drifts under sudden load.

en.title: Urban parking case 63-38: plate mismatch on the monthly pass list
