We batched compact-stack retrieval by block and re-measured at the same site. The scheduling model follows historical averages only and drifts under sudden load.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 92-46).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 92-46.

title: 水产养殖案例 92-47：增氧机的滤床短路流
summary: 水产养殖第 92-47 号案例。现场反馈的是滤床短路流，排查后定位到增氧机与投饵机的配合方式。处理办法是把分池操作挪到清晨低温时段，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 夜间最低溶氧从 2.1 毫克每升升到 4.3 毫克每升（案例 92-47）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 92-47。

en.title: Aquaculture case 92-47: filter bed short-circuiting on the aerator
en.summary: Case 92-47 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the aerator interacts with the feeder. We moved partitioning to the cool early morning and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 92-47).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 92-47.

title: 城市停车案例 92-48：错峰共享车位的出场排队
summary: 城市停车第 92-48 号案例。现场反馈的是出场排队，排查后定位到错峰共享车位与道闸的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 共享车位周转率提高一倍（案例 92-48）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 92-48。

en.title: Urban parking case 92-48: exit queueing on the off-peak shared bay
en.summary: Case 92-48 in Urban parking. The reported problem was exit queueing, traced to how the off-peak shared bay interacts with the barrier gate. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: shared bay turnover doubled (case 92-48).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 92-48.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 92-49：出餐口的配菜表与实际不符
summary: 餐饮出餐第 92-49 号案例。现场反馈的是配菜表与实际不符，排查后定位到出餐口与备餐台的配合方式。处理办法是给叫号屏加了重复提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 出餐乱序投诉当月从 31 条降到 4 条（案例 92-49）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 92-49。

en.title: Restaurant service case 92-49: prep sheet mismatch on the service window
en.summary: Case 92-49 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep sheet mismatch, traced to how the service window interacts with the prep counter. We added repeat prompts to the number screen and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-order complaints fell from 31 to 4 that month (case 92-49).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 92-49.

title: 农田灌溉案例 92-50：土壤湿度探头的雨后误启动
summary: 农田灌溉第 92-50 号案例。现场反馈的是雨后误启动，排查后定位到土壤湿度探头与首部过滤器的配合方式。处理办法是给探头加了两点标定，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 92-50）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 92-50。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 92-50: false start after rain on the soil moisture probe
en.summary: Case 92-50 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was false start after rain, traced to how the soil moisture probe interacts with the head filter. We added two-point calibration to the probe and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 92-50).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 92-50.

title: 医院排班案例 92-51：科室人力池的人力池调用越界
summary: 医院排班第 92-51 号案例。现场反馈的是人力池调用越界，排查后定位到科室人力池与加班台账的配合方式。处理办法是把连班上限写进模板校验，并在同一地点复测确认。算过一遍会不会超出现有产能。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 92-51）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 92-51。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 92-51: out-of-scope pool borrowing on the department staffing pool
en.summary: Case 92-51 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was out-of-scope pool borrowing, traced to how the department staffing pool interacts with the overtime ledger. We moved the back-to-back cap into template validation and re-measured at the same site. We worked out whether it would exceed current capacity.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 92-51).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 92-51.

title: 地铁调度案例 92-52：客流闸机的间隔波动
summary: 地铁调度第 92-52 号案例。现场反馈的是间隔波动，排查后定位到客流闸机与早高峰加开车的配合方式。处理办法是给加开车固定了占用窗口，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 早高峰间隔波动从 ±35 秒收到 ±12 秒（案例 92-52）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 92-52。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 92-52: headway jitter on the passenger gate
en.summary: Case 92-52 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was headway jitter, traced to how the passenger gate interacts with the peak extra train. We fixed an occupancy window for extra trains and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 92-52).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 92-52.

title: 冷链物流案例 92-53：装卸月台的箱门密封失效
summary: 冷链物流第 92-53 号案例。现场反馈的是箱门密封失效，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是按里程与季节重算干冰配额，并在同一地点复测确认。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。
outcome: 月台温升从 6.5 摄氏度降到 2.1 摄氏度（案例 92-53）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 92-53。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 92-53: door seal failure on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 92-53 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was door seal failure, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We recomputed dry ice quota by distance and season and re-measured at the same site. We had to judge whether the weather made it a one-off.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 92-53).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 92-53.

title: 快递分拣案例 92-54：面单识别相机的面单识别率下降
summary: 快递分拣第 92-54 号案例。现场反馈的是面单识别率下降，排查后定位到面单识别相机与异形件通道的配合方式。处理办法是把返流皮带速度与主线解耦，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 92-54。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 92-54: label recognition drop on the label camera
en.summary: Case 92-54 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was label recognition drop, traced to how the label camera interacts with the irregular-item lane. We decoupled recirculation belt speed from the main line and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 92-54).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 92-54.

title: 光伏运维案例 92-55：清洗机器人的倾角季节性偏差
summary: 光伏运维第 92-55 号案例。现场反馈的是倾角季节性偏差，排查后定位到清洗机器人与倾角支架的配合方式。处理办法是按组串电流分布重新分组，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 同口径发电量差异从 6% 收到 1%（案例 92-55）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 92-55。

en.title: PV plant operations case 92-55: seasonal tilt deviation on the cleaning robot
en.summary: Case 92-55 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was seasonal tilt deviation, traced to how the cleaning robot interacts with the tilt mount. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: same-definition generation gap narrowed from 6% to 1% (case 92-55).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 92-55.

title: 图书借阅案例 92-56：逾期通知的索书号错架
summary: 图书借阅第 92-56 号案例。现场反馈的是索书号错架，排查后定位到逾期通知与密集书库的配合方式。处理办法是把逾期通知改成三段提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。争论点是能不能只改一处就够。
outcome: 逾期通知送达率从 82% 升到 99%（案例 92-56）。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 92-56。

en.title: Library lending case 92-56: misshelved call numbers on the overdue notice
en.summary: Case 92-56 in Library lending. The reported problem was misshelved call numbers, traced to how the overdue notice interacts with the compact stacks. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. The argument was whether changing one place would be enough.
en.outcome: overdue notice delivery rose from 82% to 99% (case 92-56).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 92-56.

title: 水产养殖案例 92-57：循环水滤床的分池应激
summary: 水产养殖第 92-57 号案例。现场反馈的是分池应激，排查后定位到循环水滤床与分池网箱的配合方式。处理办法是把分池操作挪到清晨低温时段，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 92-57）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 92-57。

en.title: Aquaculture case 92-57: partitioning stress on the recirculating filter bed
en.summary: Case 92-57 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was partitioning stress, traced to how the recirculating filter bed interacts with the partition net cage. We moved partitioning to the cool early morning and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 92-57).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 92-57.

title: 城市停车案例 92-58：车位诱导屏的出场排队
summary: 城市停车第 92-58 号案例。现场反馈的是出场排队，排查后定位到车位诱导屏与高位视频桩的配合方式。处理办法是把诱导屏刷新从 5 分钟改成 30 秒，并在同一地点复测确认。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 92-58）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 92-58。

en.title: Urban parking case 92-58: exit queueing on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 92-58 in Urban parking. The reported problem was exit queueing, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 92-58).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 92-58.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 92-59：高峰配菜表的叫号漏叫
summary: 餐饮出餐第 92-59 号案例。现场反馈的是叫号漏叫，排查后定位到高峰配菜表与出餐口的配合方式。处理办法是给叫号屏加了重复提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 出餐乱序投诉当月从 31 条降到 4 条（案例 92-59）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 92-59。

en.title: Restaurant service case 92-59: missed calls on the peak prep sheet
en.summary: Case 92-59 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was missed calls, traced to how the peak prep sheet interacts with the service window. We added repeat prompts to the number screen and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-order complaints fell from 31 to 4 that month (case 92-59).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 92-59.

title: 农田灌溉案例 92-60：田间气象站的雨后误启动
summary: 农田灌溉第 92-60 号案例。现场反馈的是雨后误启动，排查后定位到田间气象站与干管阀组的配合方式。处理办法是把雨量判据从日累计改成小时累计，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。
outcome: 轮次冲突当季清零（案例 92-60）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 92-60。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 92-60: false start after rain on the field weather station
en.summary: Case 92-60 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was false start after rain, traced to how the field weather station interacts with the main valve group. We changed the rain criterion from daily to hourly and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware.
en.outcome: rotation conflicts fell to zero for the season (case 92-60).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 92-60.

title: 医院排班案例 92-61：加班台账的换班链断裂
summary: 医院排班第 92-61 号案例。现场反馈的是换班链断裂，排查后定位到加班台账与夜班组的配合方式。处理办法是给换班链加了闭环检查，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 92-61）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 92-61。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 92-61: broken swap chain on the overtime ledger
en.summary: Case 92-61 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the overtime ledger interacts with the night shift group. We added a closed-loop check to swap chains and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 92-61).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 92-61.

title: 地铁调度案例 92-62：早高峰加开车的开门时间超标
summary: 地铁调度第 92-62 号案例。现场反馈的是开门时间超标，排查后定位到早高峰加开车与站台屏蔽门的配合方式。处理办法是给加开车固定了占用窗口，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。补了一条什么时候该人工介入的判断标准。
outcome: 开门时间超标当周清零（案例 92-62）。
learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 92-62。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 92-62: door dwell overrun on the peak extra train
en.summary: Case 92-62 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was door dwell overrun, traced to how the peak extra train interacts with the platform screen door. We fixed an occupancy window for extra trains and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives. We added a rule for when a human should step in.
en.outcome: door dwell overruns fell to zero that week (case 92-62).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 92-62.

title: 冷链物流案例 92-63：冷藏箱体的预冷不足
summary: 冷链物流第 92-63 号案例。现场反馈的是预冷不足，排查后定位到冷藏箱体与温度记录仪的配合方式。处理办法是把记录仪采样从 5 分钟改成 1 分钟，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 月台温升从 6.5 摄氏度降到 2.1 摄氏度（案例 92-63）。
learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 92-63。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 92-63: insufficient pre-cooling on the refrigerated container
en.summary: Case 92-63 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was insufficient pre-cooling, traced to how the refrigerated container interacts with the temperature logger. We changed logger sampling from 5 minutes to 1 minute and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 92-63).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 92-63.

title: 快递分拣案例 92-64：异形件通道的格口爆仓
summary: 快递分拣第 92-64 号案例。现场反馈的是格口爆仓，排查后定位到异形件通道与返流皮带的配合方式。处理办法是把相机曝光改成按面单反光自适应，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 92-64。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 92-64: chute overflow on the irregular-item lane
en.summary: Case 92-64 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was chute overflow, traced to how the irregular-item lane interacts with the recirculation belt. We made camera exposure adaptive to label glare and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 92-64).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 92-64.

title: 光伏运维案例 92-65：发电量日报的组串失配
summary: 光伏运维第 92-65 号案例。现场反馈的是组串失配，排查后定位到发电量日报与组串逆变器的配合方式。处理办法是按季节调了两次倾角，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 92-65）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 92-65。

en.title: PV plant operations case 92-65: string mismatch on the daily generation report
en.summary: Case 92-65 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was string mismatch, traced to how the daily generation report interacts with the string inverter. We adjusted tilt twice by season and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 92-65).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 92-65.

title: 图书借阅案例 92-66：书目索书号的预约队列超长
summary: 图书借阅第 92-66 号案例。现场反馈的是预约队列超长，排查后定位到书目索书号与预约队列的配合方式。处理办法是把逾期通知改成三段提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。定了什么时候必须停线检查。
outcome: 预约平均等待从 11 天降到 4 天（案例 92-66）。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 92-66。

en.title: Library lending case 92-66: over-long reservation queue on the call number
en.summary: Case 92-66 in Library lending. The reported problem was over-long reservation queue, traced to how the call number interacts with the reservation queue. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. We set when the line must stop for inspection.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 92-66).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 92-66.

title: 水产养殖案例 92-67：投饵机的氨氮升高
summary: 水产养殖第 92-67 号案例。现场反馈的是氨氮升高，排查后定位到投饵机与水质探头的配合方式。处理办法是把分池操作挪到清晨低温时段，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 92-67。

en.title: Aquaculture case 92-67: rising ammonia nitrogen on the feeder
en.summary: Case 92-67 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was rising ammonia nitrogen, traced to how the feeder interacts with the water quality probe. We moved partitioning to the cool early morning and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise.
en.outcome: feed coefficient fell from 1.62 to 1.28 (case 92-67).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 92-67.

title: 城市停车案例 92-68：高位视频桩的包月名单过期

en.summary: Case 92-88 in Urban parking. The reported problem was shared bays held long-term, traced to how the monthly pass list interacts with the off-peak shared bay. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 92-88).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 92-88.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 92-89：出餐口的备餐台拥堵
summary: 餐饮出餐第 92-89 号案例。现场反馈的是备餐台拥堵，排查后定位到出餐口与备餐台的配合方式。处理办法是把外卖产能单独留了两个灶口，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。排产用的模型只按历史均值走，遇到突发就偏。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 92-89。

en.title: Restaurant service case 92-89: prep counter congestion on the service window
en.summary: Case 92-89 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep counter congestion, traced to how the service window interacts with the prep counter. We reserved two burners for takeaway capacity and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way. The scheduling model follows historical averages only and drifts under sudden load.
en.outcome: missed-call rate fell from 5.1% to 0.4% (case 92-89).
en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 92-89.

title: 农田灌溉案例 92-90：首部过滤器的末端压力不足
summary: 农田灌溉第 92-90 号案例。现场反馈的是末端压力不足，排查后定位到首部过滤器与轮灌轮次表的配合方式。处理办法是在首部加了旁通，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 末端压力从 0.12 兆帕回到 0.19 兆帕（案例 92-90）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 92-90。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 92-90: insufficient tail pressure on the head filter
en.summary: Case 92-90 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was insufficient tail pressure, traced to how the head filter interacts with the rotation table. We added a bypass at the head and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: tail pressure recovered from 0.12 MPa to 0.19 MPa (case 92-90).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 92-90.

title: 医院排班案例 92-91：加班台账的节假日缺口
summary: 医院排班第 92-91 号案例。现场反馈的是节假日缺口，排查后定位到加班台账与夜班组的配合方式。处理办法是把连班上限写进模板校验，并在同一地点复测确认。补了一条什么时候该人工介入的判断标准。
outcome: 连班超时当月从 14 例降到 0 例（案例 92-91）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 92-91。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 92-91: holiday shortfall on the overtime ledger
en.summary: Case 92-91 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was holiday shortfall, traced to how the overtime ledger interacts with the night shift group. We moved the back-to-back cap into template validation and re-measured at the same site. We added a rule for when a human should step in.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 92-91).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 92-91.

title: 地铁调度案例 92-92：客流闸机的开门时间超标
summary: 地铁调度第 92-92 号案例。现场反馈的是开门时间超标，排查后定位到客流闸机与早高峰加开车的配合方式。处理办法是让闸机限流跟着站台密度走，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 早高峰间隔波动从 ±35 秒收到 ±12 秒（案例 92-92）。
learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 92-92。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 92-92: door dwell overrun on the passenger gate
en.summary: Case 92-92 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was door dwell overrun, traced to how the passenger gate interacts with the peak extra train. We tied gate throttling to platform density and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 92-92).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 92-92.

title: 冷链物流案例 92-93：冷藏箱体的箱门密封失效
summary: 冷链物流第 92-93 号案例。现场反馈的是箱门密封失效，排查后定位到冷藏箱体与温度记录仪的配合方式。处理办法是给月台加了风幕并改了作业顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 到货温度超标批次当季从 11 批降到 1 批（案例 92-93）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 92-93。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 92-93: door seal failure on the refrigerated container
en.summary: Case 92-93 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was door seal failure, traced to how the refrigerated container interacts with the temperature logger. We added an air curtain and reordered dock operations and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-spec arrival batches fell from 11 to 1 for the season (case 92-93).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 92-93.

title: 快递分拣案例 92-94：返流皮带的交叉带打滑
summary: 快递分拣第 92-94 号案例。现场反馈的是交叉带打滑，排查后定位到返流皮带与交叉带分拣机的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。现场问过一句：能不能先按老办法顶两天。补了一段为什么之前的判据不适用。
outcome: 格口爆仓每班从 7 次降到 1 次（案例 92-94）。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 92-94。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 92-94: cross-belt slippage on the recirculation belt
en.summary: Case 92-94 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was cross-belt slippage, traced to how the recirculation belt interacts with the cross-belt sorter. We reordered chute allocation by destination flow and re-measured at the same site. Someone on site asked whether the old procedure could hold for two more days. We added a note on why the earlier criterion did not apply.
en.outcome: chute overflows per shift fell from 7 to 1 (case 92-94).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 92-94.

title: 光伏运维案例 92-95：组串逆变器的日报口径不一致
summary: 光伏运维第 92-95 号案例。现场反馈的是日报口径不一致，排查后定位到组串逆变器与汇流箱的配合方式。处理办法是让清洗周期跟着积灰速率走，并在同一地点复测确认。上线前评估过会不会影响夜间作业。
outcome: 同口径发电量差异从 6% 收到 1%（案例 92-95）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 92-95。

en.title: PV plant operations case 92-95: inconsistent report definitions on the string inverter
en.summary: Case 92-95 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was inconsistent report definitions, traced to how the string inverter interacts with the combiner box. We tied the cleaning cycle to dust accumulation rate and re-measured at the same site. Before rollout we assessed whether night operations would be affected.
en.outcome: same-definition generation gap narrowed from 6% to 1% (case 92-95).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 92-95.

title: 图书借阅案例 92-96：密集书库的索书号错架
summary: 图书借阅第 92-96 号案例。现场反馈的是索书号错架，排查后定位到密集书库与自助借还机的配合方式。处理办法是按楼层重排索书号巡架顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 预约平均等待从 11 天降到 4 天（案例 92-96）。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 92-96。

en.title: Library lending case 92-96: misshelved call numbers on the compact stacks
en.summary: Case 92-96 in Library lending. The reported problem was misshelved call numbers, traced to how the compact stacks interacts with the self-service kiosk. We reordered shelf-reading by floor and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 92-96).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 92-96.

title: 水产养殖案例 92-97：水质探头的分池应激
summary: 水产养殖第 92-97 号案例。现场反馈的是分池应激，排查后定位到水质探头与循环水滤床的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 夜间最低溶氧从 2.1 毫克每升升到 4.3 毫克每升（案例 92-97）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 92-97。

en.title: Aquaculture case 92-97: partitioning stress on the water quality probe
en.summary: Case 92-97 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was partitioning stress, traced to how the water quality probe interacts with the recirculating filter bed. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 92-97).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 92-97.

title: 城市停车案例 92-98：错峰共享车位的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 92-98 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到错峰共享车位与道闸的配合方式。处理办法是把诱导屏刷新从 5 分钟改成 30 秒，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 92-98）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 92-98。

en.title: Urban parking case 92-98: stale guidance data on the off-peak shared bay
en.summary: Case 92-98 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the off-peak shared bay interacts with the barrier gate. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 92-98).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 92-98.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 92-99：叫号屏的备餐台拥堵
summary: 餐饮出餐第 92-99 号案例。现场反馈的是备餐台拥堵，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是把出餐改成按下单时间强排序，并在同一地点复测确认。定了什么时候必须停线检查。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 92-99）。
learned: 外卖不单独留产能就一定挤堂食记录自餐饮出餐案例 92-99。

en.title: Restaurant service case 92-99: prep counter congestion on the number screen
en.summary: Case 92-99 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep counter congestion, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We forced service order by order time and re-measured at the same site. We set when the line must stop for inspection.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 92-99).
en.learned: without reserved capacity, takeaway always squeezes dine-in Recorded from Restaurant service case 92-99.

title: 农田灌溉案例 93-00：土壤湿度探头的末端压力不足
summary: 农田灌溉第 93-00 号案例。现场反馈的是末端压力不足，排查后定位到土壤湿度探头与首部过滤器的配合方式。处理办法是把反冲洗周期改成按压差触发，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 末端压力从 0.12 兆帕回到 0.19 兆帕（案例 93-00）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 93-00。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 93-00: insufficient tail pressure on the soil moisture probe
en.summary: Case 93-00 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was insufficient tail pressure, traced to how the soil moisture probe interacts with the head filter. We switched backwash to differential-pressure triggering and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: tail pressure recovered from 0.12 MPa to 0.19 MPa (case 93-00).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 93-00.

title: 医院排班案例 93-01：夜班组的人力池调用越界
summary: 医院排班第 93-01 号案例。现场反馈的是人力池调用越界，排查后定位到夜班组与值班表模板的配合方式。处理办法是让台账以打卡为准，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 93-01）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 93-01。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 93-01: out-of-scope pool borrowing on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 93-01 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was out-of-scope pool borrowing, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We made clock-in authoritative for the ledger and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 93-01).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 93-01.

title: 地铁调度案例 93-02：客流闸机的开门时间超标
summary: 地铁调度第 93-02 号案例。现场反馈的是开门时间超标，排查后定位到客流闸机与早高峰加开车的配合方式。处理办法是让闸机限流跟着站台密度走，并在同一地点复测确认。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 折返作业时间从 142 秒压到 118 秒（案例 93-02）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 93-02。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 93-02: door dwell overrun on the passenger gate
en.summary: Case 93-02 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was door dwell overrun, traced to how the passenger gate interacts with the peak extra train. We tied gate throttling to platform density and re-measured at the same site. We had to judge whether the weather made it a one-off. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 93-02).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 93-02.

title: 冷链物流案例 93-03：装卸月台的预冷不足
summary: 冷链物流第 93-03 号案例。现场反馈的是预冷不足，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是把记录仪采样从 5 分钟改成 1 分钟，并在同一地点复测确认。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。写明什么时候可以跳过复核。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 93-03）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 93-03。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 93-03: insufficient pre-cooling on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 93-03 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was insufficient pre-cooling, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We changed logger sampling from 5 minutes to 1 minute and re-measured at the same site. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way. This step is most often missed during shift handover. We spelled out when the review can be skipped.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 93-03).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 93-03.

title: 快递分拣案例 93-04：格口分配表的面单识别率下降
summary: 快递分拣第 93-04 号案例。现场反馈的是面单识别率下降，排查后定位到格口分配表与面单识别相机的配合方式。处理办法是把返流皮带速度与主线解耦，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 格口爆仓每班从 7 次降到 1 次（案例 93-04）。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 93-04。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 93-04: label recognition drop on the chute allocation table
en.summary: Case 93-04 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was label recognition drop, traced to how the chute allocation table interacts with the label camera. We decoupled recirculation belt speed from the main line and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: chute overflows per shift fell from 7 to 1 (case 93-04).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 93-04.

title: 光伏运维案例 93-05：发电量日报的汇流箱温升
summary: 光伏运维第 93-05 号案例。现场反馈的是汇流箱温升，排查后定位到发电量日报与组串逆变器的配合方式。处理办法是让清洗周期跟着积灰速率走，并在同一地点复测确认。现场问过一句：能不能先按老办法顶两天。
outcome: 组串失配损失从 4.1% 降到 1.3%（案例 93-05）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 93-05。

en.title: PV plant operations case 93-05: combiner box temperature rise on the daily generation report
en.summary: Case 93-05 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the daily generation report interacts with the string inverter. We tied the cleaning cycle to dust accumulation rate and re-measured at the same site. Someone on site asked whether the old procedure could hold for two more days.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 93-05).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 93-05.

title: 图书借阅案例 93-06：自助借还机的借还机识别失败
summary: 图书借阅第 93-06 号案例。现场反馈的是借还机识别失败，排查后定位到自助借还机与书目索书号的配合方式。处理办法是给预约队列加了到馆时限，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 93-06。

en.title: Library lending case 93-06: kiosk read failures on the self-service kiosk
en.summary: Case 93-06 in Library lending. The reported problem was kiosk read failures, traced to how the self-service kiosk interacts with the call number. We added a pickup deadline to the reservation queue and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 93-06).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 93-06.

title: 水产养殖案例 93-07：投饵机的投饵过量
summary: 水产养殖第 93-07 号案例。现场反馈的是投饵过量，排查后定位到投饵机与水质探头的配合方式。处理办法是把增氧机改成按溶氧闭环启停，并在同一地点复测确认。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 93-07）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 93-07。

en.title: Aquaculture case 93-07: overfeeding on the feeder
en.summary: Case 93-07 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was overfeeding, traced to how the feeder interacts with the water quality probe. We switched aerators to closed-loop dissolved-oxygen control and re-measured at the same site. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 93-07).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 93-07.

title: 城市停车案例 93-08：高位视频桩的包月名单过期
summary: 城市停车第 93-08 号案例。现场反馈的是包月名单过期，排查后定位到高位视频桩与包月名单的配合方式。处理办法是把诱导屏刷新从 5 分钟改成 30 秒，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 93-08）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 93-08。

en.title: Urban parking case 93-08: expired pass list on the overhead video pole
en.summary: Case 93-08 in Urban parking. The reported problem was expired pass list, traced to how the overhead video pole interacts with the monthly pass list. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 93-08).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 93-08.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 93-09：叫号屏的出餐乱序
summary: 餐饮出餐第 93-09 号案例。现场反馈的是出餐乱序，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是给叫号屏加了重复提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 93-09。

en.title: Restaurant service case 93-09: out-of-order service on the number screen
en.summary: Case 93-09 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We added repeat prompts to the number screen and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: missed-call rate fell from 5.1% to 0.4% (case 93-09).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 93-09.

title: 农田灌溉案例 93-10：土壤湿度探头的过滤器堵塞频繁
summary: 农田灌溉第 93-10 号案例。现场反馈的是过滤器堵塞频繁，排查后定位到土壤湿度探头与首部过滤器的配合方式。处理办法是在首部加了旁通，并在同一地点复测确认。争论点是能不能只改一处就够。补了一段为什么之前的判据不适用。
outcome: 末端压力从 0.12 兆帕回到 0.19 兆帕（案例 93-10）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 93-10。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 93-10: frequent filter clogging on the soil moisture probe
en.summary: Case 93-10 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was frequent filter clogging, traced to how the soil moisture probe interacts with the head filter. We added a bypass at the head and re-measured at the same site. The argument was whether changing one place would be enough. We added a note on why the earlier criterion did not apply.
en.outcome: tail pressure recovered from 0.12 MPa to 0.19 MPa (case 93-10).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 93-10.

title: 医院排班案例 93-11：值班表模板的台账与打卡不符
summary: 医院排班第 93-11 号案例。现场反馈的是台账与打卡不符，排查后定位到值班表模板与换班申请单的配合方式。处理办法是把节假日缺口提前四周预警，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 连班超时当月从 14 例降到 0 例（案例 93-11）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 93-11。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 93-11: ledger and clock-in mismatch on the roster template
en.summary: Case 93-11 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was ledger and clock-in mismatch, traced to how the roster template interacts with the swap request form. We raised holiday shortfall alerts four weeks ahead and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 93-11).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 93-11.

title: 地铁调度案例 93-12：折返线的间隔波动
summary: 地铁调度第 93-12 号案例。现场反馈的是间隔波动，排查后定位到折返线与列车间隔表的配合方式。处理办法是按站间实际运行时分重算间隔表，并在同一地点复测确认。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。
outcome: 早高峰间隔波动从 ±35 秒收到 ±12 秒（案例 93-12）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 93-12。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 93-12: headway jitter on the turnback track
en.summary: Case 93-12 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was headway jitter, traced to how the turnback track interacts with the headway table. We recomputed the headway table from measured section times and re-measured at the same site. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 93-12).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 93-12.

title: 冷链物流案例 93-13：温度记录仪的月台温升
summary: 冷链物流第 93-13 号案例。现场反馈的是月台温升，排查后定位到温度记录仪与装卸月台的配合方式。处理办法是把记录仪采样从 5 分钟改成 1 分钟，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 93-13）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 93-13。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 93-13: dock temperature rise on the temperature logger
en.summary: Case 93-13 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dock temperature rise, traced to how the temperature logger interacts with the loading dock. We changed logger sampling from 5 minutes to 1 minute and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 93-13).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 93-13.

title: 快递分拣案例 93-14：格口分配表的返流比例升高
summary: 快递分拣第 93-14 号案例。现场反馈的是返流比例升高，排查后定位到格口分配表与面单识别相机的配合方式。处理办法是把相机曝光改成按面单反光自适应，并在同一地点复测确认。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。
outcome: 格口爆仓每班从 7 次降到 1 次（案例 93-14）。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 93-14。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 93-14: rising recirculation ratio on the chute allocation table
en.summary: Case 93-14 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was rising recirculation ratio, traced to how the chute allocation table interacts with the label camera. We made camera exposure adaptive to label glare and re-measured at the same site. We had to judge whether the weather made it a one-off.
en.outcome: chute overflows per shift fell from 7 to 1 (case 93-14).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 93-14.

title: 光伏运维案例 93-15：清洗机器人的汇流箱温升
summary: 光伏运维第 93-15 号案例。现场反馈的是汇流箱温升，排查后定位到清洗机器人与倾角支架的配合方式。处理办法是按季节调了两次倾角，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 组串失配损失从 4.1% 降到 1.3%（案例 93-15）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 93-15。

en.title: PV plant operations case 93-15: combiner box temperature rise on the cleaning robot
en.summary: Case 93-15 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the cleaning robot interacts with the tilt mount. We adjusted tilt twice by season and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 93-15).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 93-15.

title: 图书借阅案例 93-16：自助借还机的预约队列超长
summary: 图书借阅第 93-16 号案例。现场反馈的是预约队列超长，排查后定位到自助借还机与书目索书号的配合方式。处理办法是把逾期通知改成三段提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。
outcome: 预约平均等待从 11 天降到 4 天（案例 93-16）。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 93-16。

en.title: Library lending case 93-16: over-long reservation queue on the self-service kiosk
en.summary: Case 93-16 in Library lending. The reported problem was over-long reservation queue, traced to how the self-service kiosk interacts with the call number. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 93-16).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 93-16.

title: 水产养殖案例 93-17：循环水滤床的溶氧夜间跌落
summary: 水产养殖第 93-17 号案例。现场反馈的是溶氧夜间跌落，排查后定位到循环水滤床与分池网箱的配合方式。处理办法是把增氧机改成按溶氧闭环启停，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 93-17。

en.title: Aquaculture case 93-17: night dissolved-oxygen drop on the recirculating filter bed
en.summary: Case 93-17 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was night dissolved-oxygen drop, traced to how the recirculating filter bed interacts with the partition net cage. We switched aerators to closed-loop dissolved-oxygen control and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: feed coefficient fell from 1.62 to 1.28 (case 93-17).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 93-17.

title: 城市停车案例 93-18：高位视频桩的诱导屏数据滞后
summary: 城市停车第 93-18 号案例。现场反馈的是诱导屏数据滞后，排查后定位到高位视频桩与包月名单的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 93-18）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 93-18。

en.title: Urban parking case 93-18: stale guidance data on the overhead video pole
en.summary: Case 93-18 in Urban parking. The reported problem was stale guidance data, traced to how the overhead video pole interacts with the monthly pass list. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 93-18).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 93-18.

summary: 餐饮出餐第 93-19 号案例。现场反馈的是外卖与堂食抢产能，排查后定位到叫号屏与外卖打包区的配合方式。处理办法是把备餐台按冷热分区，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 93-19。

en.title: Restaurant service case 93-19: takeaway competing with dine-in on the number screen
en.summary: Case 93-19 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was takeaway competing with dine-in, traced to how the number screen interacts with the takeaway packing area. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: missed-call rate fell from 5.1% to 0.4% (case 93-19).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 93-19.

title: 农田灌溉案例 93-20：轮灌轮次表的过滤器堵塞频繁
summary: 农田灌溉第 93-20 号案例。现场反馈的是过滤器堵塞频繁，排查后定位到轮灌轮次表与田间气象站的配合方式。处理办法是给探头加了两点标定，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 93-20）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 93-20。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 93-20: frequent filter clogging on the rotation table
en.summary: Case 93-20 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was frequent filter clogging, traced to how the rotation table interacts with the field weather station. We added two-point calibration to the probe and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 93-20).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 93-20.

title: 医院排班案例 93-21：值班表模板的换班链断裂
summary: 医院排班第 93-21 号案例。现场反馈的是换班链断裂，排查后定位到值班表模板与换班申请单的配合方式。处理办法是把节假日缺口提前四周预警，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 连班超时当月从 14 例降到 0 例（案例 93-21）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 93-21。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 93-21: broken swap chain on the roster template
en.summary: Case 93-21 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the roster template interacts with the swap request form. We raised holiday shortfall alerts four weeks ahead and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 93-21).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 93-21.

title: 地铁调度案例 93-22：客流闸机的闸机限流不及时
summary: 地铁调度第 93-22 号案例。现场反馈的是闸机限流不及时，排查后定位到客流闸机与早高峰加开车的配合方式。处理办法是把折返作业拆成两段并行，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 折返作业时间从 142 秒压到 118 秒（案例 93-22）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 93-22。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 93-22: late gate throttling on the passenger gate
en.summary: Case 93-22 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was late gate throttling, traced to how the passenger gate interacts with the peak extra train. We split the turnback into two parallel phases and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 93-22).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 93-22.

title: 冷链物流案例 93-23：装卸月台的记录仪掉点
summary: 冷链物流第 93-23 号案例。现场反馈的是记录仪掉点，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是把预冷时长按品类分档，并在同一地点复测确认。需要判断是不是天气造成的偶发。
outcome: 记录仪掉点率从 3.4% 降到 0.2%（案例 93-23）。
learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 93-23。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 93-23: logger data gaps on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 93-23 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was logger data gaps, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We tiered pre-cooling time by product category and re-measured at the same site. We had to judge whether the weather made it a one-off.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 93-23).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 93-23.

title: 快递分拣案例 93-24：异形件通道的返流比例升高
summary: 快递分拣第 93-24 号案例。现场反馈的是返流比例升高，排查后定位到异形件通道与返流皮带的配合方式。处理办法是在入口加了异形件预分流，并在同一地点复测确认。

en.summary: Case 93-24 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was rising recirculation ratio, traced to how the irregular-item lane interacts with the recirculation belt. We added irregular-item pre-diversion at the inlet and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: chute overflows per shift fell from 7 to 1 (case 93-24).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 93-24.

learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 93-25。

en.title: PV plant operations case 93-25: inconsistent report definitions on the daily generation report
en.summary: Case 93-25 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was inconsistent report definitions, traced to how the daily generation report interacts with the string inverter. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 93-25).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 93-25.

title: 图书借阅案例 93-26：书目索书号的逾期通知漏发
summary: 图书借阅第 93-26 号案例。现场反馈的是逾期通知漏发，排查后定位到书目索书号与预约队列的配合方式。处理办法是把逾期通知改成三段提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。预测用的模型换过一次参数，口径随之更新。
outcome: 预约平均等待从 11 天降到 4 天（案例 93-26）。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 93-26。

en.title: Library lending case 93-26: missed overdue notices on the call number
en.summary: Case 93-26 in Library lending. The reported problem was missed overdue notices, traced to how the call number interacts with the reservation queue. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. The forecasting model had its parameters changed once, and the metric definition followed.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 93-26).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 93-26.

title: 水产养殖案例 93-27：增氧机的溶氧夜间跌落

learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 93-27。

en.title: Aquaculture case 93-27: night dissolved-oxygen drop on the aerator
en.summary: Case 93-27 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was night dissolved-oxygen drop, traced to how the aerator interacts with the feeder. We recomputed feeding rate by body weight and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 93-27).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 93-27.

title: 城市停车案例 93-28：高位视频桩的车牌识别错配
summary: 城市停车第 93-28 号案例。现场反馈的是车牌识别错配，排查后定位到高位视频桩与包月名单的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。估算用的模型没考虑季节项。定了什么时候必须停线检查。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 93-28）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 93-28。

en.title: Urban parking case 93-28: plate mismatch on the overhead video pole
en.summary: Case 93-28 in Urban parking. The reported problem was plate mismatch, traced to how the overhead video pole interacts with the monthly pass list. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware. The estimation model left out the seasonal term. We set when the line must stop for inspection.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 93-28).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 93-28.
