summary: 地铁调度第 97-22 号案例。现场反馈的是闸机限流不及时，排查后定位到客流闸机与早高峰加开车的配合方式。处理办法是让闸机限流跟着站台密度走，并在同一地点复测确认。核对了是不是上一版参数没同步。
outcome: 早高峰间隔波动从 ±35 秒收到 ±12 秒（案例 97-22）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 97-22。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 97-22: late gate throttling on the passenger gate
en.summary: Case 97-22 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was late gate throttling, traced to how the passenger gate interacts with the peak extra train. We tied gate throttling to platform density and re-measured at the same site. We checked whether the previous parameter set had not been synced.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 97-22).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 97-22.

title: 冷链物流案例 97-23：温度记录仪的预冷不足
summary: 冷链物流第 97-23 号案例。现场反馈的是预冷不足，排查后定位到温度记录仪与装卸月台的配合方式。处理办法是给月台加了风幕并改了作业顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。现场问过一句：能不能先按老办法顶两天。
outcome: 到货温度超标批次当季从 11 批降到 1 批（案例 97-23）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 97-23。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 97-23: insufficient pre-cooling on the temperature logger
en.summary: Case 97-23 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was insufficient pre-cooling, traced to how the temperature logger interacts with the loading dock. We added an air curtain and reordered dock operations and re-measured at the same site. Someone on site asked whether the old procedure could hold for two more days.
en.outcome: out-of-spec arrival batches fell from 11 to 1 for the season (case 97-23).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 97-23.

title: 快递分拣案例 97-24：格口分配表的面单识别率下降
summary: 快递分拣第 97-24 号案例。现场反馈的是面单识别率下降，排查后定位到格口分配表与面单识别相机的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。
outcome: 格口爆仓每班从 7 次降到 1 次（案例 97-24）。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 97-24。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 97-24: label recognition drop on the chute allocation table
en.summary: Case 97-24 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was label recognition drop, traced to how the chute allocation table interacts with the label camera. We reordered chute allocation by destination flow and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way.
en.outcome: chute overflows per shift fell from 7 to 1 (case 97-24).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 97-24.

title: 光伏运维案例 97-25：倾角支架的组串失配
summary: 光伏运维第 97-25 号案例。现场反馈的是组串失配，排查后定位到倾角支架与发电量日报的配合方式。处理办法是按季节调了两次倾角，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。
outcome: 同口径发电量差异从 6% 收到 1%（案例 97-25）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 97-25。

en.title: PV plant operations case 97-25: string mismatch on the tilt mount
en.summary: Case 97-25 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was string mismatch, traced to how the tilt mount interacts with the daily generation report. We adjusted tilt twice by season and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware.
en.outcome: same-definition generation gap narrowed from 6% to 1% (case 97-25).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 97-25.

title: 图书借阅案例 97-26：密集书库的借还机识别失败
summary: 图书借阅第 97-26 号案例。现场反馈的是借还机识别失败，排查后定位到密集书库与自助借还机的配合方式。处理办法是把逾期通知改成三段提醒，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 97-26。

en.title: Library lending case 97-26: kiosk read failures on the compact stacks
en.summary: Case 97-26 in Library lending. The reported problem was kiosk read failures, traced to how the compact stacks interacts with the self-service kiosk. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 97-26).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 97-26.

title: 水产养殖案例 97-27：分池网箱的溶氧夜间跌落
summary: 水产养殖第 97-27 号案例。现场反馈的是溶氧夜间跌落，排查后定位到分池网箱与增氧机的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。先看有没有更早的告警被当成噪声。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 97-27。

en.title: Aquaculture case 97-27: night dissolved-oxygen drop on the partition net cage
en.summary: Case 97-27 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was night dissolved-oxygen drop, traced to how the partition net cage interacts with the aerator. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site. We first looked for earlier alarms dismissed as noise. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: feed coefficient fell from 1.62 to 1.28 (case 97-27).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 97-27.

title: 城市停车案例 97-28：高位视频桩的车牌识别错配
summary: 城市停车第 97-28 号案例。现场反馈的是车牌识别错配，排查后定位到高位视频桩与包月名单的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 97-28）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 97-28。

en.title: Urban parking case 97-28: plate mismatch on the overhead video pole
en.summary: Case 97-28 in Urban parking. The reported problem was plate mismatch, traced to how the overhead video pole interacts with the monthly pass list. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 97-28).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 97-28.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 97-29：备餐台的出餐乱序
summary: 餐饮出餐第 97-29 号案例。现场反馈的是出餐乱序，排查后定位到备餐台与叫号屏的配合方式。处理办法是把出餐改成按下单时间强排序，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 出餐乱序投诉当月从 31 条降到 4 条（案例 97-29）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 97-29。

en.title: Restaurant service case 97-29: out-of-order service on the prep counter
en.summary: Case 97-29 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the prep counter interacts with the number screen. We forced service order by order time and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-order complaints fell from 31 to 4 that month (case 97-29).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 97-29.

title: 农田灌溉案例 97-30：田间气象站的探头读数漂移
summary: 农田灌溉第 97-30 号案例。现场反馈的是探头读数漂移，排查后定位到田间气象站与干管阀组的配合方式。处理办法是在首部加了旁通，并在同一地点复测确认。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。写明什么时候可以跳过复核。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 97-30）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 97-30。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 97-30: probe reading drift on the field weather station
en.summary: Case 97-30 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was probe reading drift, traced to how the field weather station interacts with the main valve group. We added a bypass at the head and re-measured at the same site. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream. We spelled out when the review can be skipped.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 97-30).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 97-30.

title: 医院排班案例 97-31：夜班组的换班链断裂
summary: 医院排班第 97-31 号案例。现场反馈的是换班链断裂，排查后定位到夜班组与值班表模板的配合方式。处理办法是给换班链加了闭环检查，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 97-31）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 97-31。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 97-31: broken swap chain on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 97-31 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was broken swap chain, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We added a closed-loop check to swap chains and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 97-31).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 97-31.

title: 地铁调度案例 97-32：折返线的开门时间超标
summary: 地铁调度第 97-32 号案例。现场反馈的是开门时间超标，排查后定位到折返线与列车间隔表的配合方式。处理办法是给加开车固定了占用窗口，并在同一地点复测确认。上线前评估过会不会影响夜间作业。补了一条什么时候该人工介入的判断标准。
outcome: 开门时间超标当周清零（案例 97-32）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 97-32。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 97-32: door dwell overrun on the turnback track
en.summary: Case 97-32 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was door dwell overrun, traced to how the turnback track interacts with the headway table. We fixed an occupancy window for extra trains and re-measured at the same site. Before rollout we assessed whether night operations would be affected. We added a rule for when a human should step in.
en.outcome: door dwell overruns fell to zero that week (case 97-32).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 97-32.

title: 冷链物流案例 97-33：装卸月台的干冰配额不够
summary: 冷链物流第 97-33 号案例。现场反馈的是干冰配额不够，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是给月台加了风幕并改了作业顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。上线前评估过会不会影响夜间作业。
outcome: 月台温升从 6.5 摄氏度降到 2.1 摄氏度（案例 97-33）。
learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 97-33。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 97-33: dry ice quota shortfall on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 97-33 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dry ice quota shortfall, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We added an air curtain and reordered dock operations and re-measured at the same site. Before rollout we assessed whether night operations would be affected.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 97-33).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 97-33.

title: 快递分拣案例 97-34：异形件通道的异形件误入主线
summary: 快递分拣第 97-34 号案例。现场反馈的是异形件误入主线，排查后定位到异形件通道与返流皮带的配合方式。处理办法是把返流皮带速度与主线解耦，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 97-34。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 97-34: irregular items entering the main line on the irregular-item lane
en.summary: Case 97-34 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was irregular items entering the main line, traced to how the irregular-item lane interacts with the recirculation belt. We decoupled recirculation belt speed from the main line and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware.
en.outcome: label recognition recovered from 93.5% to 99.1% (case 97-34).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 97-34.
concepts: irregular items entering the main line

title: 光伏运维案例 97-35：倾角支架的汇流箱温升
summary: 光伏运维第 97-35 号案例。现场反馈的是汇流箱温升，排查后定位到倾角支架与发电量日报的配合方式。处理办法是让清洗周期跟着积灰速率走，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 组串失配损失从 4.1% 降到 1.3%（案例 97-35）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 97-35。

en.title: PV plant operations case 97-35: combiner box temperature rise on the tilt mount
en.summary: Case 97-35 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was combiner box temperature rise, traced to how the tilt mount interacts with the daily generation report. We tied the cleaning cycle to dust accumulation rate and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 97-35).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 97-35.

title: 图书借阅案例 97-36：预约队列的密集书库取书慢
summary: 图书借阅第 97-36 号案例。现场反馈的是密集书库取书慢，排查后定位到预约队列与逾期通知的配合方式。处理办法是给预约队列加了到馆时限，并在同一地点复测确认。核对了是不是上一版参数没同步。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
learned: 错架靠巡架顺序解决，不靠加人记录自图书借阅案例 97-36。

en.title: Library lending case 97-36: slow retrieval from compact stacks on the reservation queue
en.summary: Case 97-36 in Library lending. The reported problem was slow retrieval from compact stacks, traced to how the reservation queue interacts with the overdue notice. We added a pickup deadline to the reservation queue and re-measured at the same site. We checked whether the previous parameter set had not been synced. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 97-36).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 97-36.

title: 水产养殖案例 97-37：增氧机的溶氧夜间跌落
summary: 水产养殖第 97-37 号案例。现场反馈的是溶氧夜间跌落，排查后定位到增氧机与投饵机的配合方式。处理办法是把分池操作挪到清晨低温时段，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 97-37）。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 97-37。

en.title: Aquaculture case 97-37: night dissolved-oxygen drop on the aerator
en.summary: Case 97-37 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was night dissolved-oxygen drop, traced to how the aerator interacts with the feeder. We moved partitioning to the cool early morning and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: three-day mortality after partitioning fell from 4.5% to 0.9% (case 97-37).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 97-37.

title: 城市停车案例 97-38：高位视频桩的车牌识别错配
summary: 城市停车第 97-38 号案例。现场反馈的是车牌识别错配，排查后定位到高位视频桩与包月名单的配合方式。处理办法是把诱导屏刷新从 5 分钟改成 30 秒，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 97-38）。
learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 97-38。

en.title: Urban parking case 97-38: plate mismatch on the overhead video pole
en.summary: Case 97-38 in Urban parking. The reported problem was plate mismatch, traced to how the overhead video pole interacts with the monthly pass list. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 97-38).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 97-38.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 97-39：高峰配菜表的出餐乱序
summary: 餐饮出餐第 97-39 号案例。现场反馈的是出餐乱序，排查后定位到高峰配菜表与出餐口的配合方式。处理办法是把备餐台按冷热分区，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 出餐乱序投诉当月从 31 条降到 4 条（案例 97-39）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 97-39。

en.title: Restaurant service case 97-39: out-of-order service on the peak prep sheet
en.summary: Case 97-39 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was out-of-order service, traced to how the peak prep sheet interacts with the service window. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-order complaints fell from 31 to 4 that month (case 97-39).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 97-39.

title: 农田灌溉案例 97-40：田间气象站的过滤器堵塞频繁
summary: 农田灌溉第 97-40 号案例。现场反馈的是过滤器堵塞频繁，排查后定位到田间气象站与干管阀组的配合方式。处理办法是把雨量判据从日累计改成小时累计，并在同一地点复测确认。核对了是不是上一版参数没同步。
outcome: 反冲洗次数每天从 9 次降到 3 次（案例 97-40）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 97-40。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 97-40: frequent filter clogging on the field weather station
en.summary: Case 97-40 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was frequent filter clogging, traced to how the field weather station interacts with the main valve group. We changed the rain criterion from daily to hourly and re-measured at the same site. We checked whether the previous parameter set had not been synced.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 97-40).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 97-40.

title: 医院排班案例 97-41：值班表模板的节假日缺口
summary: 医院排班第 97-41 号案例。现场反馈的是节假日缺口，排查后定位到值班表模板与换班申请单的配合方式。处理办法是给换班链加了闭环检查，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 连班超时当月从 14 例降到 0 例（案例 97-41）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 97-41。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 97-41: holiday shortfall on the roster template
en.summary: Case 97-41 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was holiday shortfall, traced to how the roster template interacts with the swap request form. We added a closed-loop check to swap chains and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 97-41).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 97-41.

title: 地铁调度案例 97-42：客流闸机的加开车占用冲突
summary: 地铁调度第 97-42 号案例。现场反馈的是加开车占用冲突，排查后定位到客流闸机与早高峰加开车的配合方式。处理办法是给加开车固定了占用窗口，并在同一地点复测确认。

learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 97-42。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 97-42: extra-train occupancy conflict on the passenger gate

en.title: Parcel sorting case 97-84: chute overflow on the recirculation belt
en.summary: Case 97-84 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was chute overflow, traced to how the recirculation belt interacts with the cross-belt sorter. We decoupled recirculation belt speed from the main line and re-measured at the same site. The forecasting model had its parameters changed once, and the metric definition followed.
en.outcome: label recognition recovered from 93.5% to 99.1% (case 97-84).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 97-84.

title: 光伏运维案例 97-85：清洗机器人的日报口径不一致
summary: 光伏运维第 97-85 号案例。现场反馈的是日报口径不一致，排查后定位到清洗机器人与倾角支架的配合方式。处理办法是按季节调了两次倾角，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 组串失配损失从 4.1% 降到 1.3%（案例 97-85）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 97-85。

en.title: PV plant operations case 97-85: inconsistent report definitions on the cleaning robot
en.summary: Case 97-85 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was inconsistent report definitions, traced to how the cleaning robot interacts with the tilt mount. We adjusted tilt twice by season and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 97-85).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 97-85.

title: 图书借阅案例 97-86：预约队列的逾期通知漏发
summary: 图书借阅第 97-86 号案例。现场反馈的是逾期通知漏发，排查后定位到预约队列与逾期通知的配合方式。处理办法是按楼层重排索书号巡架顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 逾期通知送达率从 82% 升到 99%（案例 97-86）。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 97-86。

en.title: Library lending case 97-86: missed overdue notices on the reservation queue
en.summary: Case 97-86 in Library lending. The reported problem was missed overdue notices, traced to how the reservation queue interacts with the overdue notice. We reordered shelf-reading by floor and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: overdue notice delivery rose from 82% to 99% (case 97-86).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 97-86.

title: 水产养殖案例 97-87：循环水滤床的投饵过量
summary: 水产养殖第 97-87 号案例。现场反馈的是投饵过量，排查后定位到循环水滤床与分池网箱的配合方式。处理办法是按体重重算投饵率，并在同一地点复测确认。顺手查了有没有类似记录被漏掉。
outcome: 夜间最低溶氧从 2.1 毫克每升升到 4.3 毫克每升（案例 97-87）。
learned: 定时增氧一定既费电又缺氧记录自水产养殖案例 97-87。

en.title: Aquaculture case 97-87: overfeeding on the recirculating filter bed
en.summary: Case 97-87 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was overfeeding, traced to how the recirculating filter bed interacts with the partition net cage. We recomputed feeding rate by body weight and re-measured at the same site. We also checked whether similar records had been missed.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 97-87).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 97-87.

title: 城市停车案例 97-88：车位诱导屏的出场排队
summary: 城市停车第 97-88 号案例。现场反馈的是出场排队，排查后定位到车位诱导屏与高位视频桩的配合方式。处理办法是把诱导屏刷新从 5 分钟改成 30 秒，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 识别错配从每天 26 起降到 3 起（案例 97-88）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 97-88。

en.title: Urban parking case 97-88: exit queueing on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 97-88 in Urban parking. The reported problem was exit queueing, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We changed guidance refresh from 5 minutes to 30 seconds and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: plate mismatches fell from 26 per day to 3 (case 97-88).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 97-88.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 97-89：外卖打包区的备餐台拥堵
summary: 餐饮出餐第 97-89 号案例。现场反馈的是备餐台拥堵，排查后定位到外卖打包区与高峰配菜表的配合方式。处理办法是把备餐台按冷热分区，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 97-89。

en.title: Restaurant service case 97-89: prep counter congestion on the takeaway packing area
en.summary: Case 97-89 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep counter congestion, traced to how the takeaway packing area interacts with the peak prep sheet. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: missed-call rate fell from 5.1% to 0.4% (case 97-89).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 97-89.

title: 农田灌溉案例 97-90：轮灌轮次表的探头读数漂移
summary: 农田灌溉第 97-90 号案例。现场反馈的是探头读数漂移，排查后定位到轮灌轮次表与田间气象站的配合方式。处理办法是把反冲洗周期改成按压差触发，并在同一地点复测确认。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。
outcome: 轮次冲突当季清零（案例 97-90）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 97-90。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 97-90: probe reading drift on the rotation table
en.summary: Case 97-90 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was probe reading drift, traced to how the rotation table interacts with the field weather station. We switched backwash to differential-pressure triggering and re-measured at the same site. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way.
en.outcome: rotation conflicts fell to zero for the season (case 97-90).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 97-90.

title: 医院排班案例 97-91：加班台账的节假日缺口
summary: 医院排班第 97-91 号案例。现场反馈的是节假日缺口，排查后定位到加班台账与夜班组的配合方式。处理办法是把人力池按科室分层，并在同一地点复测确认。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 97-91）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 97-91。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 97-91: holiday shortfall on the overtime ledger
en.summary: Case 97-91 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was holiday shortfall, traced to how the overtime ledger interacts with the night shift group. We tiered the staffing pool by department and re-measured at the same site. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 97-91).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 97-91.

title: 地铁调度案例 97-92：早高峰加开车的开门时间超标
summary: 地铁调度第 97-92 号案例。现场反馈的是开门时间超标，排查后定位到早高峰加开车与站台屏蔽门的配合方式。处理办法是按站间实际运行时分重算间隔表，并在同一地点复测确认。记录了为什么最后选了这套做法而不是更省事的那套。
outcome: 早高峰间隔波动从 ±35 秒收到 ±12 秒（案例 97-92）。
learned: 间隔表用计划运行时分算就一定偏乐观记录自地铁调度案例 97-92。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 97-92: door dwell overrun on the peak extra train
en.summary: Case 97-92 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was door dwell overrun, traced to how the peak extra train interacts with the platform screen door. We recomputed the headway table from measured section times and re-measured at the same site. We recorded why this approach was chosen over the cheaper one.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 97-92).
en.learned: headway tables built on planned section times are always optimistic Recorded from Metro dispatching case 97-92.

title: 冷链物流案例 97-93：装卸月台的记录仪掉点
summary: 冷链物流第 97-93 号案例。现场反馈的是记录仪掉点，排查后定位到装卸月台与预冷间的配合方式。处理办法是把记录仪采样从 5 分钟改成 1 分钟，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 到货温度超标批次当季从 11 批降到 1 批（案例 97-93）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 97-93。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 97-93: logger data gaps on the loading dock
en.summary: Case 97-93 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was logger data gaps, traced to how the loading dock interacts with the pre-cooling room. We changed logger sampling from 5 minutes to 1 minute and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: out-of-spec arrival batches fell from 11 to 1 for the season (case 97-93).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 97-93.

title: 快递分拣案例 97-94：格口分配表的返流比例升高
summary: 快递分拣第 97-94 号案例。现场反馈的是返流比例升高，排查后定位到格口分配表与面单识别相机的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 97-94。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 97-94: rising recirculation ratio on the chute allocation table
en.summary: Case 97-94 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was rising recirculation ratio, traced to how the chute allocation table interacts with the label camera. We reordered chute allocation by destination flow and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 97-94).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 97-94.

title: 光伏运维案例 97-95：组串逆变器的倾角季节性偏差
summary: 光伏运维第 97-95 号案例。现场反馈的是倾角季节性偏差，排查后定位到组串逆变器与汇流箱的配合方式。处理办法是按季节调了两次倾角，并在同一地点复测确认。预测用的模型换过一次参数，口径随之更新。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 97-95）。
learned: 清洗按固定周期一定浪费一半人力记录自光伏运维案例 97-95。

en.title: PV plant operations case 97-95: seasonal tilt deviation on the string inverter
en.summary: Case 97-95 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was seasonal tilt deviation, traced to how the string inverter interacts with the combiner box. We adjusted tilt twice by season and re-measured at the same site. The forecasting model had its parameters changed once, and the metric definition followed.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 97-95).
en.learned: fixed cleaning cycles always waste half the labour Recorded from PV plant operations case 97-95.

title: 图书借阅案例 97-96：自助借还机的预约队列超长
summary: 图书借阅第 97-96 号案例。现场反馈的是预约队列超长，排查后定位到自助借还机与书目索书号的配合方式。处理办法是把密集书库取书按区块批量化，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
learned: 预约队列没有时限就会被占住记录自图书借阅案例 97-96。

en.title: Library lending case 97-96: over-long reservation queue on the self-service kiosk
en.summary: Case 97-96 in Library lending. The reported problem was over-long reservation queue, traced to how the self-service kiosk interacts with the call number. We batched compact-stack retrieval by block and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 97-96).
en.learned: a reservation queue without deadlines gets squatted Recorded from Library lending case 97-96.

title: 水产养殖案例 97-97：水质探头的溶氧夜间跌落
summary: 水产养殖第 97-97 号案例。现场反馈的是溶氧夜间跌落，排查后定位到水质探头与循环水滤床的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 投饵率按尾数算永远偏高记录自水产养殖案例 97-97。

en.title: Aquaculture case 97-97: night dissolved-oxygen drop on the water quality probe
en.summary: Case 97-97 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was night dissolved-oxygen drop, traced to how the water quality probe interacts with the recirculating filter bed. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: feed coefficient fell from 1.62 to 1.28 (case 97-97).
en.learned: feeding rate computed per head is always too high Recorded from Aquaculture case 97-97.

title: 城市停车案例 97-98：道闸的车牌识别错配
summary: 城市停车第 97-98 号案例。现场反馈的是车牌识别错配，排查后定位到道闸与车位诱导屏的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。争论点是能不能只改一处就够。
outcome: 出场平均排队从 92 秒降到 31 秒（案例 97-98）。
learned: 识别单靠一次比对，错配就一定进账单记录自城市停车案例 97-98。

en.title: Urban parking case 97-98: plate mismatch on the barrier gate
en.summary: Case 97-98 in Urban parking. The reported problem was plate mismatch, traced to how the barrier gate interacts with the guidance screen. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site. The argument was whether changing one place would be enough.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 97-98).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 97-98.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 97-99：备餐台的备餐台拥堵
summary: 餐饮出餐第 97-99 号案例。现场反馈的是备餐台拥堵，排查后定位到备餐台与叫号屏的配合方式。处理办法是把外卖产能单独留了两个灶口，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 97-99）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 97-99。

en.title: Restaurant service case 97-99: prep counter congestion on the prep counter
en.summary: Case 97-99 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep counter congestion, traced to how the prep counter interacts with the number screen. We reserved two burners for takeaway capacity and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 97-99).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 97-99.

title: 农田灌溉案例 98-00：田间气象站的末端压力不足
summary: 农田灌溉第 98-00 号案例。现场反馈的是末端压力不足，排查后定位到田间气象站与干管阀组的配合方式。处理办法是给探头加了两点标定，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 反冲洗次数每天从 9 次降到 3 次（案例 98-00）。
learned: 地块高差比管径更能解释末端压力记录自农田灌溉案例 98-00。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 98-00: insufficient tail pressure on the field weather station
en.summary: Case 98-00 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was insufficient tail pressure, traced to how the field weather station interacts with the main valve group. We added two-point calibration to the probe and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 98-00).
en.learned: plot elevation explains tail pressure better than pipe diameter Recorded from Farm irrigation case 98-00.

title: 医院排班案例 98-01：加班台账的台账与打卡不符
summary: 医院排班第 98-01 号案例。现场反馈的是台账与打卡不符，排查后定位到加班台账与夜班组的配合方式。处理办法是把人力池按科室分层，并在同一地点复测确认。写清为什么这次没有沿用去年的方案。
outcome: 断裂换班链不再进入正式表（案例 98-01）。
learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 98-01。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 98-01: ledger and clock-in mismatch on the overtime ledger
en.summary: Case 98-01 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was ledger and clock-in mismatch, traced to how the overtime ledger interacts with the night shift group. We tiered the staffing pool by department and re-measured at the same site. We wrote down why last year's plan was not reused.
en.outcome: broken swap chains no longer reach the published roster (case 98-01).
en.learned: the ledger and clock-in cannot both be authoritative Recorded from Hospital rostering case 98-01.

title: 地铁调度案例 98-02：客流闸机的开门时间超标
summary: 地铁调度第 98-02 号案例。现场反馈的是开门时间超标，排查后定位到客流闸机与早高峰加开车的配合方式。处理办法是让闸机限流跟着站台密度走，并在同一地点复测确认。补了一段为什么之前的判据不适用。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 折返作业时间从 142 秒压到 118 秒（案例 98-02）。
learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 98-02。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 98-02: door dwell overrun on the passenger gate
en.summary: Case 98-02 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was door dwell overrun, traced to how the passenger gate interacts with the peak extra train. We tied gate throttling to platform density and re-measured at the same site. We added a note on why the earlier criterion did not apply. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 98-02).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 98-02.

title: 冷链物流案例 98-03：干冰配额表的箱门密封失效
summary: 冷链物流第 98-03 号案例。现场反馈的是箱门密封失效，排查后定位到干冰配额表与冷藏箱体的配合方式。处理办法是把预冷时长按品类分档，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 月台温升从 6.5 摄氏度降到 2.1 摄氏度（案例 98-03）。
learned: 温升多半发生在月台，不在路上记录自冷链物流案例 98-03。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 98-03: door seal failure on the dry ice quota table
en.summary: Case 98-03 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was door seal failure, traced to how the dry ice quota table interacts with the refrigerated container. We tiered pre-cooling time by product category and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: dock temperature rise fell from 6.5 °C to 2.1 °C (case 98-03).
en.learned: most temperature rise happens at the dock, not in transit Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 98-03.

title: 快递分拣案例 98-04：面单识别相机的返流比例升高
summary: 快递分拣第 98-04 号案例。现场反馈的是返流比例升高，排查后定位到面单识别相机与异形件通道的配合方式。处理办法是在入口加了异形件预分流，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
learned: 识别率下降先查反光，再查镜头记录自快递分拣案例 98-04。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 98-04: rising recirculation ratio on the label camera
en.summary: Case 98-04 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was rising recirculation ratio, traced to how the label camera interacts with the irregular-item lane. We added irregular-item pre-diversion at the inlet and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: label recognition recovered from 93.5% to 99.1% (case 98-04).
en.learned: when recognition drops, check glare before the lens Recorded from Parcel sorting case 98-04.

title: 光伏运维案例 98-05：清洗机器人的组串失配
summary: 光伏运维第 98-05 号案例。现场反馈的是组串失配，排查后定位到清洗机器人与倾角支架的配合方式。处理办法是按组串电流分布重新分组，并在同一地点复测确认。
outcome: 组串失配损失从 4.1% 降到 1.3%（案例 98-05）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 98-05。

en.title: PV plant operations case 98-05: string mismatch on the cleaning robot
en.summary: Case 98-05 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was string mismatch, traced to how the cleaning robot interacts with the tilt mount. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: mismatch loss fell from 4.1% to 1.3% (case 98-05).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 98-05.

title: 图书借阅案例 98-06：自助借还机的逾期通知漏发

en.summary: Case 98-06 in Library lending. The reported problem was missed overdue notices, traced to how the self-service kiosk interacts with the call number. We split overdue notices into three stages and re-measured at the same site. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.

en.summary: Case 98-07 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the recirculating filter bed interacts with the partition net cage. en.summary: Case 98-26 in Library lending. The reported problem was kiosk read failures, traced to how the self-service kiosk interacts with the call number. We batched compact-stack retrieval by block and re-measured at the same site. We added a note on why the earlier criterion did not apply. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.
en.outcome: average reservation wait fell from 11 days to 4 (case 98-26).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 98-26.

title: 水产养殖案例 98-27：投饵机的氨氮升高
summary: 水产养殖第 98-27 号案例。现场反馈的是氨氮升高，排查后定位到投饵机与水质探头的配合方式。处理办法是按体重重算投饵率，并在同一地点复测确认。现场问过一句：能不能先按老办法顶两天。

en.title: Aquaculture case 98-27: rising ammonia nitrogen on the feeder
en.summary: Case 98-27 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was rising ammonia nitrogen, traced to how the feeder interacts with the water quality probe. We recomputed feeding rate by body weight and re-measured at the same site. Someone on site asked whether the old procedure could hold for two more days.
en.outcome: night minimum dissolved oxygen rose from 2.1 mg/L to 4.3 mg/L (case 98-27).
en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 98-27.

title: 城市停车案例 98-28：车位诱导屏的共享车位被长期占用
summary: 城市停车第 98-28 号案例。现场反馈的是共享车位被长期占用，排查后定位到车位诱导屏与高位视频桩的配合方式。处理办法是给共享车位加了时段锁，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。

learned: 诱导屏滞后五分钟等于没有诱导记录自城市停车案例 98-28。

en.title: Urban parking case 98-28: shared bays held long-term on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 98-28 in Urban parking. The reported problem was shared bays held long-term, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We added time-window locks to shared bays and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 98-28).
en.learned: guidance five minutes stale is no guidance Recorded from Urban parking case 98-28.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 98-29：出餐口的备餐台拥堵
summary: 餐饮出餐第 98-29 号案例。现场反馈的是备餐台拥堵，排查后定位到出餐口与备餐台的配合方式。处理办法是把备餐台按冷热分区，并在同一地点复测确认。先确认了是不是同一批设备都有这个表现。
outcome: 高峰平均等餐从 18 分钟降到 9 分钟（案例 98-29）。
learned: 乱序不是厨房慢，是没有强排序记录自餐饮出餐案例 98-29。

en.title: Restaurant service case 98-29: prep counter congestion on the service window
en.summary: Case 98-29 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep counter congestion, traced to how the service window interacts with the prep counter. We split the prep counter into hot and cold zones and re-measured at the same site. We first confirmed whether the whole device batch behaved this way.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 98-29).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 98-29.

title: 农田灌溉案例 98-30：干管阀组的探头读数漂移
summary: 农田灌溉第 98-30 号案例。现场反馈的是探头读数漂移，排查后定位到干管阀组与土壤湿度探头的配合方式。处理办法是给探头加了两点标定，并在同一地点复测确认。争论点是能不能只改一处就够。
outcome: 同一地块两次读数差降到 2% 以内（案例 98-30）。
learned: 探头标定必须两点，单点标定掩盖零漂记录自农田灌溉案例 98-30。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 98-30: probe reading drift on the main valve group
en.summary: Case 98-30 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was probe reading drift, traced to how the main valve group interacts with the soil moisture probe. We added two-point calibration to the probe and re-measured at the same site. The argument was whether changing one place would be enough.
en.outcome: the gap between two readings on the same plot fell under 2% (case 98-30).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 98-30.

title: 医院排班案例 98-31：夜班组的人力池调用越界
summary: 医院排班第 98-31 号案例。现场反馈的是人力池调用越界，排查后定位到夜班组与值班表模板的配合方式。处理办法是把人力池按科室分层，并在同一地点复测确认。写清为什么这次没有沿用去年的方案。
outcome: 节假日缺口提前四周暴露（案例 98-31）。
learned: 换班必须闭环校验，单向审批一定漏记录自医院排班案例 98-31。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 98-31: out-of-scope pool borrowing on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 98-31 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was out-of-scope pool borrowing, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We tiered the staffing pool by department and re-measured at the same site. We wrote down why last year's plan was not reused.
en.outcome: holiday shortfalls surface four weeks early (case 98-31).
en.learned: swaps need closed-loop validation; one-way approval always leaks Recorded from Hospital rostering case 98-31.

title: 地铁调度案例 98-32：列车间隔表的闸机限流不及时
summary: 地铁调度第 98-32 号案例。现场反馈的是闸机限流不及时，排查后定位到列车间隔表与客流闸机的配合方式。处理办法是按站间实际运行时分重算间隔表，并在同一地点复测确认。算过一遍会不会超出现有产能。

learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 98-32。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 98-32: late gate throttling on the headway table
en.summary: Case 98-32 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was late gate throttling, traced to how the headway table interacts with the passenger gate. We recomputed the headway table from measured section times and re-measured at the same site. We worked out whether it would exceed current capacity.
en.outcome: peak headway jitter narrowed from ±35 s to ±12 s (case 98-32).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 98-32.

title: 冷链物流案例 98-33：冷藏箱体的预冷不足
summary: 冷链物流第 98-33 号案例。现场反馈的是预冷不足，排查后定位到冷藏箱体与温度记录仪的配合方式。处理办法是给月台加了风幕并改了作业顺序，并在同一地点复测确认。

learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 98-33。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 98-33: insufficient pre-cooling on the refrigerated container
en.summary: Case 98-33 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was insufficient pre-cooling, traced to how the refrigerated container interacts with the temperature logger. We added an air curtain and reordered dock operations and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: logger gap rate fell from 3.4% to 0.2% (case 98-33).
en.learned: sampling interval decides whether short spikes are visible at all Recorded from Cold chain logistics case 98-33.

title: 快递分拣案例 98-34：面单识别相机的面单识别率下降
summary: 快递分拣第 98-34 号案例。现场反馈的是面单识别率下降，排查后定位到面单识别相机与异形件通道的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。
learned: 爆仓是分配表问题，不是产能问题记录自快递分拣案例 98-34。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 98-34: label recognition drop on the label camera
en.summary: Case 98-34 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was label recognition drop, traced to how the label camera interacts with the irregular-item lane. We reordered chute allocation by destination flow and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: recirculation ratio fell from 8.2% to 2.6% (case 98-34).
en.learned: overflow is an allocation-table problem, not a throughput one Recorded from Parcel sorting case 98-34.

title: 光伏运维案例 98-35：汇流箱的日报口径不一致
summary: 光伏运维第 98-35 号案例。现场反馈的是日报口径不一致，排查后定位到汇流箱与清洗机器人的配合方式。处理办法是按组串电流分布重新分组，并在同一地点复测确认。当时先问的是能不能不动硬件就把这件事压下去。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。
outcome: 汇流箱高温告警当月从 23 条降到 2 条（案例 98-35）。
learned: 日报口径不统一，任何对比都不成立记录自光伏运维案例 98-35。

en.title: PV plant operations case 98-35: inconsistent report definitions on the combiner box
en.summary: Case 98-35 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was inconsistent report definitions, traced to how the combiner box interacts with the cleaning robot. We regrouped strings by current distribution and re-measured at the same site. The first question was whether this could be solved without touching the hardware. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: combiner high-temperature alarms fell from 23 to 2 that month (case 98-35).
en.learned: with inconsistent report definitions no comparison holds Recorded from PV plant operations case 98-35.

title: 图书借阅案例 98-36：逾期通知的密集书库取书慢
summary: 图书借阅第 98-36 号案例。现场反馈的是密集书库取书慢，排查后定位到逾期通知与密集书库的配合方式。处理办法是把密集书库取书按区块批量化，并在同一地点复测确认。人手最紧的时候这条流程最先崩。担心的是会不会把问题推到下游。

en.title: Library lending case 98-36: slow retrieval from compact stacks on the overdue notice
en.summary: Case 98-36 in Library lending. The reported problem was slow retrieval from compact stacks, traced to how the overdue notice interacts with the compact stacks. We batched compact-stack retrieval by block and re-measured at the same site. This procedure breaks first when staffing is tightest. The worry was whether it pushed the problem downstream.
en.outcome: misshelving fell from 2.8% to 0.6% (case 98-36).
en.learned: misshelving is fixed by shelf-reading order, not headcount Recorded from Library lending case 98-36.

title: 水产养殖案例 98-37：分池网箱的滤床短路流
summary: 水产养殖第 98-37 号案例。现场反馈的是滤床短路流，排查后定位到分池网箱与增氧机的配合方式。处理办法是给滤床加了布水板，并在同一地点复测确认。复盘时排查了有没有别的班次也受同样影响。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。
outcome: 分池后三日死亡率从 4.5% 降到 0.9%（案例 98-37）。

en.title: Aquaculture case 98-37: filter bed short-circuiting on the partition net cage
en.summary: Case 98-37 in Aquaculture. The reported problem was filter bed short-circuiting, traced to how the partition net cage interacts with the aerator. We added a distribution plate to the filter bed and re-measured at the same site. The review checked whether other shifts were affected the same way. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives.

en.learned: timer-based aeration both wastes power and still runs short Recorded from Aquaculture case 98-37.

summary: 城市停车第 98-38 号案例。现场反馈的是共享车位被长期占用，排查后定位到车位诱导屏与高位视频桩的配合方式。处理办法是把识别结果加了二次比对，并在同一地点复测确认。

en.title: Urban parking case 98-38: shared bays held long-term on the guidance screen
en.summary: Case 98-38 in Urban parking. The reported problem was shared bays held long-term, traced to how the guidance screen interacts with the overhead video pole. We added a second comparison to plate results and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: average exit queueing fell from 92 s to 31 s (case 98-38).
en.learned: with a single comparison, mismatches always reach the bill Recorded from Urban parking case 98-38.

title: 餐饮出餐案例 98-39：出餐口的备餐台拥堵
summary: 餐饮出餐第 98-39 号案例。现场反馈的是备餐台拥堵，排查后定位到出餐口与备餐台的配合方式。处理办法是把出餐改成按下单时间强排序，并在同一地点复测确认。交接班的时候最容易漏掉这一步。

en.title: Restaurant service case 98-39: prep counter congestion on the service window
en.summary: Case 98-39 in Restaurant service. The reported problem was prep counter congestion, traced to how the service window interacts with the prep counter. We forced service order by order time and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: peak average wait fell from 18 minutes to 9 (case 98-39).
en.learned: out-of-order service is a missing sort, not a slow kitchen Recorded from Restaurant service case 98-39.

summary: 农田灌溉第 98-40 号案例。现场反馈的是探头读数漂移，排查后定位到轮灌轮次表与田间气象站的配合方式。处理办法是把雨量判据从日累计改成小时累计，并在同一地点复测确认。雨季来的时候这套参数要重调。预测用的模型换过一次参数，口径随之更新。

en.title: Farm irrigation case 98-40: probe reading drift on the rotation table
en.summary: Case 98-40 in Farm irrigation. The reported problem was probe reading drift, traced to how the rotation table interacts with the field weather station. We changed the rain criterion from daily to hourly and re-measured at the same site. These parameters need retuning when the rainy season arrives. The forecasting model had its parameters changed once, and the metric definition followed.
en.outcome: daily backwash count dropped from 9 to 3 (case 98-40).
en.learned: probes need two-point calibration; one point hides zero drift Recorded from Farm irrigation case 98-40.

summary: 医院排班第 98-41 号案例。现场反馈的是连班超时，排查后定位到夜班组与值班表模板的配合方式。处理办法是把连班上限写进模板校验，并在同一地点复测确认。

learned: 台账与打卡只能有一个权威来源记录自医院排班案例 98-41。

en.title: Hospital rostering case 98-41: back-to-back shift overrun on the night shift group
en.summary: Case 98-41 in Hospital rostering. The reported problem was back-to-back shift overrun, traced to how the night shift group interacts with the roster template. We moved the back-to-back cap into template validation and re-measured at the same site.
en.outcome: monthly back-to-back overruns fell from 14 to 0 (case 98-41).

title: 地铁调度案例 98-42：列车间隔表的闸机限流不及时

learned: 限流要跟站台密度，不能跟进站人数记录自地铁调度案例 98-42。

en.title: Metro dispatching case 98-42: late gate throttling on the headway table
en.summary: Case 98-42 in Metro dispatching. The reported problem was late gate throttling, traced to how the headway table interacts with the passenger gate. We tied gate throttling to platform density and re-measured at the same site. This step is most often missed during shift handover.
en.outcome: turnback time fell from 142 s to 118 s (case 98-42).
en.learned: throttling must follow platform density, not entry counts Recorded from Metro dispatching case 98-42.

title: 冷链物流案例 98-43：冷藏箱体的干冰配额不够
summary: 冷链物流第 98-43 号案例。现场反馈的是干冰配额不够，排查后定位到冷藏箱体与温度记录仪的配合方式。处理办法是按里程与季节重算干冰配额，并在同一地点复测确认。争论点是能不能只改一处就够。

learned: 采样间隔决定短时温升是否可见记录自冷链物流案例 98-43。

en.title: Cold chain logistics case 98-43: dry ice quota shortfall on the refrigerated container
en.summary: Case 98-43 in Cold chain logistics. The reported problem was dry ice quota shortfall, traced to how the refrigerated container interacts with the temperature logger. We recomputed dry ice quota by distance and season and re-measured at the same site. The argument was whether changing one place would be enough.
en.outcome: out-of-spec arrival batches fell from 11 to 1 for the season (case 98-43).

title: 快递分拣案例 98-44：返流皮带的返流比例升高
summary: 快递分拣第 98-44 号案例。现场反馈的是返流比例升高，排查后定位到返流皮带与交叉带分拣机的配合方式。处理办法是按流向重排格口分配表，并在同一地点复测确认。

en.title: Parcel sorting case 98-44: rising recirculation ratio on the recirculation belt
en.summary: Case 98-44 in Parcel sorting. The reported problem was rising recirculation ratio, traced to how the recirculation belt interacts with the cross-belt sorter. We reordered chute allocation by destination flow and re-measured at the same site.

en.title: PV plant operations case 98-45: string mismatch on the daily generation report
en.summary: Case 98-45 in PV plant operations. The reported problem was string mismatch, traced to how the daily generation report interacts with the string inverter. en.outcome: same-definition generation gap narrowed from 6% to 1% (case 98-45).

title: 图书借阅案例 98-46：密集书库的借还机识别失败
